import NFB_ReturnedBuffers
import NFB_TerminalAssociation
import NEB_PureFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_GeometryComposed
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace
open NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

/-- Concrete full model G: exact partial Result, persistent state and semantic
effects. Native physical interpretation is a separately checked hybrid packet;
this does not assert empty native panic I/O or verify the compiler. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State Event : Type} (queries : Array U32 22#usize)
 (start finish : Usize) (state : State) :
 NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
  (Port3_QueryInstall.result (resultMap answer
   (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)))=
 NEB_PureFrame.run state (Port3_GeometryStage.geometry adopted queries start finish) :=
 NEB_PureFrame.equality state _ _ (NEW_GeometryComplete.complete queries start finish)

/-- Root-owned native domain only. Every inner call/buffer/size/trace is
DERIVED from this root's accepted Result and the same terminal computation. -/
theorem accepted_physical (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize)
 (deployed : NFB_RangeTrace.Deployed start finish) (heap : Heap)
 (out : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (accepted : resultMap answer
  (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)=ok (.Ok out)) :
 ∃ (rows : List Row) (lines flat prefixes : Vec) (product suffix : U32) (resized inverse : Vec)
   (groups : alloc.vec.Vec (Array U32 5#usize)),
 rows.length=finish.val-start.val ∧ flat.val=rows.flatMap (fun r=>r.words) ∧
 lines.val=rows.map (fun r=>r.lineZ) ∧ out.start=start ∧ out.line_z=lines ∧ out.inverses=groups ∧
 adopted.op13 flat.deref=ok (prefixes,product) ∧ prefixes.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
 adopted.op11 product=ok suffix ∧ resized.val=List.replicate flat.val.length 0#u32 ∧
 NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0_loop0
  (Port4C_Reverse.reverse (alloc.vec.Vec.len flat)) flat prefixes suffix resized=ok inverse ∧
 inverse.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
 NEW_GeometryReverse.Trace flat.val prefixes.val flat.val.length resized.val suffix inverse.val
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.suffixAfter flat.val flat.val.length suffix)
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.callLog flat.val prefixes.val flat.val.length suffix) ∧
 out.inverses.val=(List.range lines.val.length).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse) ∧
 NFB_CollectorTrace.finish (NFB_CollectorTrace.fill out.inverses.val
  (⟨[],0⟩ : NFB_CollectorTrace.Guard (Array U32 5#usize)))=⟨out.inverses.val,out.inverses.val.length⟩ ∧
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows) (NFB_ReturnedBuffers.initial heap)
  Place.lines.id=some out.line_z.val ∧
 (∀ count,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run ((NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows).take count)
  (NFB_ReturnedBuffers.initial heap) 0=heap 0) ∧
 (∀ count,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run
  ((NFB_TerminalFrame.actions flat.val prefixes.val suffix flat.val.length groups.val).take count)
  (NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows) (NFB_ReturnedBuffers.initial heap)) 0=heap 0) := by
 obtain ⟨order,bound,n⟩ := NFB_RangeTrace.bounds start finish deployed
 obtain ⟨rows,it,lines,flat,prefixes,product,suffix,groups,nrows,hflat,hlines,size,plen,
  hp,hs,hstart,hline,hgroups,ending,last,payload,gatherFrame,terminalFrame⟩ :=
  NFB_ReturnedBuffers.complete queries start finish deployed heap out accepted
 have lineLength : lines.val.length=rows.length := by rw [hlines,List.length_map]
 have count : lines.val.length≤22 := by rw [lineLength,nrows];omega
 have positive : 0<flat.val.length := by rcases n with h|h <;> omega
 have nonempty : flat.val≠[] := by intro h;rw [h] at positive;cases positive
 obtain ⟨ps,prod,suff,resized,inverse,hp1,len1,hs1,resizeValue,back,inverseLength,trace,contents,publication⟩ :=
  NFB_TerminalAssociation.complete start it lines flat out ending nonempty count (by omega) last
 have same : (ps,prod)=(prefixes,product) := Result.ok.inj (hp1.symm.trans hp)
 cases same
 have suffixSame : suff=suffix := Result.ok.inj (hs1.symm.trans hs)
 subst suff
 exact ⟨rows,lines,flat,prefixes,product,suffix,resized,inverse,groups,nrows,hflat,hlines,
  hstart,hline,hgroups,hp,plen,hs,resizeValue,back,inverseLength,trace,contents,publication,
  payload,gatherFrame,terminalFrame⟩
#print axioms result_state_effects
#print axioms accepted_physical
end NFB_GeometryComposed
end

NFB_ReturnedBuffers.source:
import NFB_AcceptedGather
import NFB_TerminalCuts
import NFB_TerminalFrame
import NFB_PrefixDomain
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_ReturnedBuffers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace
open NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

def initial (heap : Heap) : Heap :=
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run [allocate .lines [],allocate .flat []] heap

theorem initial_frame (heap : Heap) :
 initial heap 0=heap 0 ∧ initial heap Place.flat.id=some [] ∧
 initial heap Place.lines.id=some [] := by
 simp [initial,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run,allocate,Action.apply,write,Place.id]

/-- The actual successful root fixes the SAME gather, terminal, and returned
line allocation. Its physical query frame is composed without a trace premise. -/
theorem complete (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize)
 (deployed : NFB_RangeTrace.Deployed start finish) (heap : Heap)
 (out : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (accepted : resultMap answer
  (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)=ok (.Ok out)) :
 ∃ (rows : List Row) (terminal : It) (lines flat prefixes : Vec)
   (product suffix : U32) (groups : alloc.vec.Vec (Array U32 5#usize)),
 rows.length=finish.val-start.val ∧
 flat.val=rows.flatMap (fun r=>r.words) ∧ lines.val=rows.map (fun r=>r.lineZ) ∧
 flat.val.length=5*rows.length ∧ prefixes.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
 adopted.op13 flat.deref=ok (prefixes,product) ∧ adopted.op11 product=ok suffix ∧
 out.start=start ∧ out.line_z=lines ∧ out.inverses=groups ∧
 terminal.i=terminal.slice.val.length ∧
 Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start terminal lines flat=ok (done (.Ok out)) ∧
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows) (initial heap) Place.lines.id=some out.line_z.val ∧
 (∀ count,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run ((NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows).take count) (initial heap) 0=heap 0) ∧
 (∀ count,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run
  ((NFB_TerminalFrame.actions flat.val prefixes.val suffix flat.val.length groups.val).take count)
  (NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows) (initial heap)) 0=heap 0) := by
 obtain ⟨order,bound,count⟩ := NFB_RangeTrace.bounds start finish deployed
 obtain ⟨rows,terminal,lines,flat,nrows,hflat,hlines,size,lineSize,ending,last⟩ :=
  NFB_AcceptedGather.complete queries start finish order bound out accepted
 have positive : 0<flat.val.length := by rcases count with c|c <;> omega
 have nonempty : flat.val≠[] := by intro h;rw [h] at positive;cases positive
 obtain ⟨prefixes,product,suffix,zero,resized,inverse,rev,mapped,groups,
  hp,hs,hz,hr,hrev,hback,hmap,hcollect,startField,lineField,groupsField⟩ :=
  NFB_TerminalCuts.complete start terminal lines flat out ending nonempty last
 obtain ⟨ps,prod,prefixRun,prefixLength⟩ := NFB_PrefixDomain.complete flat (by omega)
 have same : (ps,prod)=(prefixes,product) := Result.ok.inj (prefixRun.symm.trans hp)
 cases same
 obtain ⟨initialQuery,initialFlat,initialLines⟩ := initial_frame heap
 obtain ⟨flatPayload,linePayload⟩ := NFB_GatherFrame.payloads rows (initial heap) [] [] initialFlat initialLines
 have frame := fun count=>NFB_GatherFrame.query_frame rows (initial heap) count
 refine ⟨rows,terminal,lines,flat,prefixes,product,suffix,groups,nrows,hflat,hlines,?_,prefixLength,
  hp,hs,startField,lineField,groupsField,ending,last,?_,?_,?_⟩
 · omega
 · rw [lineField,hlines]
   simpa only [List.nil_append] using linePayload
 · intro count
   exact (frame count).trans initialQuery
 · intro count
   rw [NFB_TerminalFrame.query_frame]
   exact (NFB_PhysicalFrame.trace_frame _ (initial heap) 0
    (fun a ha=>NFB_PrivateFrame.disjoint a (NFB_GatherFrame.owned rows a ha))).trans initialQuery
#print axioms initial_frame
#print axioms complete
end NFB_ReturnedBuffers
end

NFB_AcceptedGather.source:
import NFB_TraceBounds
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_AcceptedGather
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

theorem complete (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize)
 (order : start.val≤finish.val) (bound : finish.val≤22)
 (out : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (accepted : resultMap answer
  (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)=ok (.Ok out)) :
 ∃ (rows : List Row) (terminal : It) (lines flat : Vec),
 rows.length=finish.val-start.val ∧
 flat.val=rows.flatMap (fun r=>r.words) ∧ lines.val=rows.map (fun r=>r.lineZ) ∧
 flat.val.length=5*(finish.val-start.val) ∧ lines.val.length=finish.val-start.val ∧
 terminal.i=terminal.slice.val.length ∧
 Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted
  start terminal lines flat=ok (done (.Ok out)) := by
 obtain ⟨slice,read,window,length,trace⟩ := NFB_RangeTrace.complete queries start finish order bound
 rw [accepted] at trace
 obtain ⟨rows,terminal,lines,flat,frames,same,cursor,within,last⟩ :=
  NFB_TraceBounds.terminal_bound start trace (by change 0≤slice.val.length;omega)
 have ending := NFB_TraceBounds.accepted_end start terminal lines flat out within last
 change terminal.slice=slice at same
 change terminal.i=0+rows.length at cursor
 have count : rows.length=finish.val-start.val := by
  simp only [Nat.zero_add] at cursor
  rw [same,length] at ending
  omega
 obtain ⟨flatMeaning,lineMeaning⟩ := NET_GeometryGather.meaning frames
 obtain ⟨flatLength,lineLength⟩ := NET_GeometryGather.lengths frames
 refine ⟨rows,terminal,lines,flat,count,?_,?_,?_,?_,ending,last⟩
 · simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.nil_append,List.flatMap_map,Function.comp_def] using flatMeaning
 · simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.nil_append,List.map_map,Function.comp_def] using lineMeaning
 · simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.length_nil,List.length_map,Nat.zero_add,count] using flatLength
 · simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.length_nil,List.length_map,Nat.zero_add,count] using lineLength
#print axioms complete
end NFB_AcceptedGather
end

NFB_TraceBounds.source:
import NFB_RootGather
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_TraceBounds
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace

theorem next_active (it it1 : It) (query : U32)
 (next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=ok (some query,it1)) :
 it.i < it.slice.val.length := by
 unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next at next
 split at next
 · assumption
 · cases next

theorem terminal_bound (start : Usize) {it : It} {lines flat : Vec} {result : Result Answer}
 (trace : Trace start it lines flat result) (within : it.i ≤ it.slice.val.length) :
 ∃ (rows : List Row) (terminal : It) (finalLines finalFlat : Vec),
 NET_GeometryGather.Trace (rows.map (fun r=>(r.words,r.lineZ)))
  flat.val lines.val finalFlat.val finalLines.val ∧
 terminal.slice=it.slice ∧ terminal.i=it.i+rows.length ∧
 terminal.i ≤ terminal.slice.val.length ∧
 Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted
  start terminal finalLines finalFlat=NFB_GatherChain.stopped result := by
 revert within
 induction trace with
 | failed it lines flat e observed =>
  intro within
  exact ⟨[],it,lines,flat,.done _ _,rfl,by simp,within,observed⟩
 | diverged it lines flat observed =>
  intro within
  exact ⟨[],it,lines,flat,.done _ _,rfl,by simp,within,observed⟩
 | done it lines flat value observed =>
  intro within
  exact ⟨[],it,lines,flat,.done _ _,rfl,by simp,within,observed⟩
 | step it lines flat it1 lines1 flat1 query row result next observed sameSlice cursor hf hl nz tail ih =>
  intro within
  have active := next_active it it1 query next
  have within1 : it1.i ≤ it1.slice.val.length := by rw [sameSlice,cursor];omega
  obtain ⟨rows,terminal,finalLines,finalFlat,frames,same,index,limit,last⟩ := ih within1
  refine ⟨row::rows,terminal,finalLines,finalFlat,?_,same.trans sameSlice,?_,limit,last⟩
  · exact NET_GeometryGather.Trace.step (row.words,row.lineZ) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hf hl
     (by simp only [Port4C_GeometryGather.Row.words,List.length_cons,List.length_nil]) frames
  · simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

theorem accepted_end (start : Usize) (it : It) (lines flat : Vec)
 (out : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry) (within : it.i ≤ it.slice.val.length)
 (accepted : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
 adopted start it lines flat=ok (done (.Ok out))) : it.i=it.slice.val.length := by
 by_contra h
 have active : it.i < it.slice.val.length := by omega
 have next:=NFB_QueryIterator.next it active
 have impossible:=Port4C_GeometryControl.active_not_done adopted start it
  {it with i:=it.i+1} it.slice.val[it.i] lines flat out next
 rw [NFB_GeometryInstall.standard] at impossible
 exact impossible accepted
#print axioms next_active
#print axioms terminal_bound
#print axioms accepted_end
end NFB_TraceBounds
end

NFB_RootGather.source:
import NFB_ActualStep
import NFB_GatherFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_RootGather
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace
open NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

/-- Physical gather association. The SAME ordered heap writes and terminal
buffers are derived from the actual root, for every raw query array. -/
theorem complete (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize)
 (order : start.val≤finish.val) (bound : finish.val≤22) (heap : Heap)
 (emptyFlat : heap Place.flat.id=some []) (emptyLines : heap Place.lines.id=some []) :
 ∃ (slice : Slice U32) (rows : List Row) (terminal : It) (lines flat : Vec),
  slice.val=(queries.val.drop start.val).take (finish.val-start.val) ∧
  terminal.slice=slice ∧ terminal.i=rows.length ∧
  flat.val=rows.flatMap (fun r=>r.words) ∧ lines.val=rows.map (fun r=>r.lineZ) ∧
  NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows) heap Place.flat.id=some flat.val ∧
  NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows) heap Place.lines.id=some lines.val ∧
  (∀ count, NFB_PhysicalFrame.run ((NFB_GatherFrame.actions rows).take count) heap 0=heap 0) ∧
  Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted
   start terminal lines flat=NFB_GatherChain.stopped
    (resultMap answer (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)) := by
 obtain ⟨slice,read,window,length,trace⟩ := NFB_RangeTrace.complete queries start finish order bound
 obtain ⟨rows,terminal,lines,flat,frames,same,cursor,terminalRun⟩ := NFB_GatherChain.chain start trace
 obtain ⟨flatMeaning,lineMeaning⟩ := NET_GeometryGather.meaning frames
 have hf : flat.val=rows.flatMap (fun r=>r.words) := by
  simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.nil_append,List.flatMap_map,Function.comp_def] using flatMeaning
 have hl : lines.val=rows.map (fun r=>r.lineZ) := by
  simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new,List.nil_append,List.map_map,Function.comp_def] using lineMeaning
 obtain ⟨physicalFlat,physicalLines⟩ := NFB_GatherFrame.payloads rows heap [] [] emptyFlat emptyLines
 refine ⟨slice,rows,terminal,lines,flat,window,same,?_,hf,hl,?_,?_,?_,terminalRun⟩
 · simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using cursor
 · simpa only [List.nil_append,←hf] using physicalFlat
 · simpa only [List.nil_append,←hl] using physicalLines
 · exact fun count=>NFB_GatherFrame.query_frame rows heap count
#print axioms complete
end NFB_RootGather
end

NFB_ActualStep.source:
import NFB_RangeTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_ActualStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

theorem continuation (start : Usize) (it it1 : It) (lines flat lines1 flat1 : Vec)
 (observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
 adopted start it lines flat=ok (cont (it1,lines1,flat1))) :
 NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body start it lines flat=
 ok (cont (it1,lines1,flat1)) := by
 have associated := NFB_GeometryInstall.step start it lines flat
 rw [observed] at associated
 cases h : NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body start it lines flat with
 | fail e => simp [h,resultMap] at associated
 | div => simp [h,resultMap] at associated
 | ok flow =>
  cases flow with
  | done value => simp [h,resultMap,NEW_LoopMap.flowMap] at associated
  | cont state =>
   simp only [h,resultMap,NEW_LoopMap.flowMap,Result.ok.injEq,ControlFlow.cont.injEq] at associated
   cases associated
   rfl

/-- Rejected and divergent terminal cuts are exact partial Results too. -/
theorem failed (start : Usize) (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) (error : Aeneas.Std.Error)
 (observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
 adopted start it lines flat=fail error) :
 NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body start it lines flat=fail error := by
 have associated := NFB_GeometryInstall.step start it lines flat
 rw [observed] at associated
 cases h : NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body start it lines flat <;>
  simp_all [resultMap]
#print axioms continuation
#print axioms failed
end NFB_ActualStep
end

NFB_RangeTrace.source:
import NFB_GatherChain
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_RangeTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary NFB_GatherTrace
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

def Deployed (start finish : Usize) : Prop :=
 (start=0#usize ∧ finish=10#usize) ∨ (start=10#usize ∧ finish=22#usize)

theorem bounds (start finish : Usize) (scope : Deployed start finish) :
 start.val≤finish.val ∧ finish.val≤22 ∧
 (finish.val-start.val=10 ∨ finish.val-start.val=12) := by
 rcases scope with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ <;> decide

/-- The actual selected query view is a precise window of the SAME original
array, with no fixed-query fixture or accepted-root premise. -/
theorem selected (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize)
    (order : start.val≤finish.val) (bound : finish.val≤22) :
 ∃ slice : Slice U32,
  Port4C_GeometryRange.selected queries start finish=ok slice ∧
  slice.val=(queries.val.drop start.val).take (finish.val-start.val) ∧
  slice.val.length=finish.val-start.val := by
 obtain ⟨slice,read,contents,length⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
   (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index.step_spec
     (⟨start,finish⟩ : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (Array.to_slice queries) order
     (by change finish.val≤queries.val.length;rw [queries.property];exact bound))
 refine ⟨slice,read,?_,length⟩
 change slice.val=queries.val.extract start.val finish.val at contents
 simpa only [List.extract_eq_drop_take] using contents

/-- Root association for every raw query array. Trace existence and both
initial empty buffers come from the SAME actual-emitted Result. No inner
trace, child success, domain dictionary, or whole-buffer answer is supplied. -/
theorem complete (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize)
    (order : start.val≤finish.val) (bound : finish.val≤22) :
 ∃ slice : Slice U32,
  Port4C_GeometryRange.selected queries start finish=ok slice ∧
  slice.val=(queries.val.drop start.val).take (finish.val-start.val) ∧
  slice.val.length=finish.val-start.val ∧
  Trace start ⟨slice,0⟩ (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32)
   (resultMap answer (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)) := by
 obtain ⟨slice,read,contents,length⟩ := selected queries start finish order bound
 have root : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range adopted queries start finish=
     run start ⟨slice,0⟩ (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) := by
  rw [Port4C_GeometryRange.native_range adopted queries start finish order bound,read,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl
 refine ⟨slice,read,contents,length,?_⟩
 rw [NEW_GeometryComplete.complete_raw,root]
 exact NFB_GatherTrace.complete start ⟨slice,0⟩ (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32)
   (alloc.vec.Vec.new U32) (finish.val-start.val) (by simp only;omega)

#print axioms bounds
#print axioms selected
#print axioms complete
end NFB_RangeTrace
end

NFB_GatherChain.source:
import NFB_GatherTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_GatherChain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NFB_GatherTrace NEW_GeometryDictionary

def stopped (result : Result Answer) : Result (ControlFlow (It × Vec × Vec) Answer) :=
 match result with
 | .ok value => .ok (.done value)
 | .fail e => .fail e
 | .div => .div

/-- Every complete partial computation gives ONE ordered append/frame chain
and ONE terminal body on its SAME two final buffers, including error exits.
The terminal body retains the prefix/inverse/reverse/collect calls unchanged. -/
theorem chain (start : Usize) {it : It} {lines flat : Vec} {result : Result Answer}
    (trace : Trace start it lines flat result) :
    ∃ (rows : List Row) (terminal : It) (finalLines finalFlat : Vec),
      NET_GeometryGather.Trace (rows.map (fun r => (r.words,r.lineZ)))
        flat.val lines.val finalFlat.val finalLines.val ∧
      terminal.slice=it.slice ∧ terminal.i=it.i+rows.length ∧
      Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted
        start terminal finalLines finalFlat=stopped result := by
 induction trace with
 | failed it lines flat e observed =>
   exact ⟨[],it,lines,flat,NET_GeometryGather.Trace.done _ _,rfl,by simp,observed⟩
 | diverged it lines flat observed =>
   exact ⟨[],it,lines,flat,NET_GeometryGather.Trace.done _ _,rfl,by simp,observed⟩
 | done it lines flat value observed =>
   exact ⟨[],it,lines,flat,NET_GeometryGather.Trace.done _ _,rfl,by simp,observed⟩
 | step it lines flat it1 lines1 flat1 query row result next observed sameSlice cursor hflat hlines nonzero tail ih =>
   obtain ⟨rows,terminal,finalLines,finalFlat,frames,sliceEq,indexEq,terminalRun⟩ := ih
   refine ⟨row::rows,terminal,finalLines,finalFlat,?_,sliceEq.trans sameSlice,?_,terminalRun⟩
   · exact NET_GeometryGather.Trace.step (row.words,row.lineZ)
       (rows.map (fun r => (r.words,r.lineZ))) flat.val lines.val flat1.val lines1.val
       finalFlat.val finalLines.val hflat hlines
       (by simp only [Port4C_GeometryGather.Row.words,List.length_cons,List.length_nil]) frames
   · simp only [List.length_cons]
     omega

/-- Prefix lengths, exact ordered contents and terminal cursor are all
DERIVED from the SAME full computation, not caller-supplied output choices. -/
theorem complete (start : Usize) (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) (fuel : Nat)

import NFB_GeometryInstall
import NFB_QueryIterator
import NET_GeometryGather
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFB_GatherTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryDictionary
abbrev It := core.slice.iter.Iter U32
abbrev Vec := alloc.vec.Vec U32
abbrev Answer := core.result.Result AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Error
abbrev Row := Port4C_GeometryGather.Row

def run (start : Usize) (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) : Result Answer :=
 Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 adopted it start lines flat

/-- One SAME-state trace, including failures, divergence and early rejection.
Every continuation retains its actual query and both exact mutable outputs. -/
inductive Trace (start : Usize) : It → Vec → Vec → Result Answer → Prop
 | failed (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) (e : Aeneas.Std.Error)
     (observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start it lines flat=fail e) :
     Trace start it lines flat (fail e)
 | diverged (it : It) (lines flat : Vec)
     (observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start it lines flat=div) :
     Trace start it lines flat div
 | done (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) (value : Answer)
     (observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start it lines flat=ok (ControlFlow.done value)) :
     Trace start it lines flat (ok value)
 | step (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) (it1 : It) (lines1 flat1 : Vec)
     (query : U32) (row : Row) (result : Result Answer)
     (next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=ok (some query,it1))
     (observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start it lines flat=ok (cont (it1,lines1,flat1)))
     (sameSlice : it1.slice=it.slice) (cursor : it1.i=it.i+1)
     (flatFrame : flat1.val=flat.val++row.words)
     (lineFrame : lines1.val=lines.val++[row.lineZ])
     (nonzero : ∀ x∈row.words,x≠0#u32)
     (tail : Trace start it1 lines1 flat1 result) : Trace start it lines flat result

/-- Trace existence is DERIVED from the actual adopted partial computation;
there is no inner success, independently selected output, or trace premise. -/
theorem complete (start : Usize) (it : It) (lines flat : Vec) (fuel : Nat)
    (remaining : it.i+fuel=it.slice.val.length) :
    Trace start it lines flat (run start it lines flat) := by
 induction fuel generalizing it lines flat with
 | zero =>
   have next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=ok (none,it) :=
    NFB_QueryIterator.end_next it (by omega)
   unfold run Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0
   rw [loop.eq_def]
   simp only [uncurry]
   cases observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start it lines flat with
   | fail e => exact Trace.failed it lines flat e observed
   | div => exact Trace.diverged it lines flat observed
   | ok flow =>
    cases flow with
    | done value => exact Trace.done it lines flat value observed
    | cont after =>
     rcases after with ⟨it1,lines1,flat1⟩
     have impossible := Port4C_GeometryControl.terminal_not_cont adopted start it it it1
       lines flat lines1 flat1 next
     rw [NFB_GeometryInstall.standard] at impossible
     exact False.elim (impossible observed)
 | succ fuel ih =>
   have active : it.i < it.slice.val.length := by omega
   let query := it.slice.val[it.i]
   let it1 : It := {it with i:=it.i+1}
   have next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=ok (some query,it1) :=
    NFB_QueryIterator.next it active
   unfold run Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0
   rw [loop.eq_def]
   simp only [uncurry]
   cases observed : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start it lines flat with
   | fail e => exact Trace.failed it lines flat e observed
   | div => exact Trace.diverged it lines flat observed
   | ok flow =>
    cases flow with
    | done value => exact Trace.done it lines flat value observed
    | cont after =>
     rcases after with ⟨itOut,lines1,flat1⟩
     have sourceStep : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
         (Port4C_GeometryStd.install adopted) start it lines flat=ok (cont (itOut,lines1,flat1)) := by
      rw [NFB_GeometryInstall.standard]
      exact observed
     obtain ⟨row,u,parent,left,right,fibre,fleft,fright,point,square,doubled,one,fields⟩ :=
       Port4C_GeometryGather.step adopted start it it1 itOut query lines lines1 flat flat1 next sourceStep
     rcases fields with ⟨same,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,nonzero,hflat,hlines⟩
     subst itOut
     have tail := ih it1 lines1 flat1 (by dsimp only [it1];omega)
     exact Trace.step it lines flat it1 lines1 flat1 query row _ next observed rfl rfl hflat hlines nonzero tail

#print axioms complete
end NFB_GatherTrace
end

/-- Reinstalling std in the already adopted dictionary changes nothing. -/
theorem standard : Port4C_GeometryStd.install adopted=adopted := by rfl

/-- Every emitted one-step Result uses the SAME iterator and both evolving
vectors; contextual arithmetic substitution has no free child premise. -/
theorem step (start : Usize) (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter U32)
    (lines flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32) :

   (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body start iter lines flat)=
 Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start iter lines flat :=

   (NEW_GeometryComplete.step start iter lines flat)

/-- Whole partial Result, including all rejection/failure/divergence branches.

    (lines flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32) :
 resultMap answer (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 iter start lines flat)=

 (NEW_GeometryRawRoot.complete_loop start iter lines flat).trans
   (NEW_GeometryComplete.complete_loop iter start lines flat)

import NFB_RowLog
import NFB_RowIndex
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_RowG
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NFB_RowLog

def reply (x y left right product : U32) : Array U32 5#usize :=
 Array.make 5#usize [x,y,left,right,product]

def model (query x y lineX lineY product : U32) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array U32 5#usize) NFB_RowRef.Error × NFB_RowRef.NFB_RowLog) := do
 let u ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize query)
 if u<262144#usize then
  let parent ← u/4#usize
  let left ← lift (Usize.wrapping_mul parent 4#usize)
  let right ← lift (Usize.wrapping_add left 3#usize)
  let doubled ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.double product
  let z ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.sub doubled 1#u32
  ok (.Ok (Array.make 5#usize [x,y,lineX,lineY,z]),
   state 4#usize
    (event 1#u8 (UScalar.cast .U32 u) 0#u32 x y)
    (event 2#u8 (UScalar.cast .U32 left) 0#u32 lineX 0#u32)
    (event 3#u8 (UScalar.cast .U32 right) 0#u32 lineY 0#u32)
    (event 4#u8 lineX lineX product 0#u32))
 else ok (.Err .Query,initial)

/-- Exact local G: all replies are arbitrary and every Result and ordered
log entry is preserved. The only branch input is the real constructor domain;
left/right domains follow from it and are not hypotheses. -/
theorem complete (query x y lineX lineY product : U32) :
 NFB_RowRef.NFB_row query (reply x y lineX lineY product) initial=
 model query x y lineX lineY product := by
 let u := UScalar.cast .Usize query
 by_cases bound : u.val<262144
 · obtain ⟨parent,left,right,division,leftEq,rightEq,lv,rv,lb,rb,_,_⟩ :=
     NEB_GeometryIndices.aligned NFB_RowRef.aspis_core.r0.Error.IndexOutOfRange u bound
   have leftRun := NFB_RowIndex.admitted left lb
   have rightRun := NFB_RowIndex.admitted right rb
   have first := NFB_RowIndex.admitted u bound
   have guard : u<262144#usize := by exact bound
   dsimp only [u] at first guard division
   simp only [NFB_RowRef.NFB_row,model,reply,initial,
    first,division,←leftEq,←rightEq,leftRun,rightRun,
    NFB_RowRef.aspis_core.r0.domain.FibreIndex.get,
    core.result.Result.map_err,AspisR1.Port4C_GeometryStd.mapError,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError.call_once,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError.call_once,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure_2.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure_2.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError.call_once,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    Array.index_usize,Array.getElem?_Usize_eq,Array.make,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row_product,
    NFB_RowLog.step0,NFB_RowLog.step1,NFB_RowLog.step2,NFB_RowLog.step3,
    NFB_RowPrimitives.double,NFB_RowPrimitives.subtract,
    NFB_RowRef.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE,guard,if_true,lift,bind_tc_ok,uncurry]
   -- Only five literal reply positions remain; no recurrence is unfolded.
   simp
 · have guard : ¬u<262144#usize := by exact bound
   have first : NFB_RowRef.aspis_core.r0.domain.FibreIndex.new u=
       ok (.Err NFB_RowRef.aspis_core.r0.Error.IndexOutOfRange) := by
    rw [NFB_RowPrimitives.index,if_neg guard]
   dsimp only [u] at first guard
   simp only [NFB_RowRef.NFB_row,model,first,
    core.result.Result.map_err,AspisR1.Port4C_GeometryStd.mapError,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError,
    NFB_RowRef.NFB_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleErrorError.call_once,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
    guard,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok,uncurry]

#print axioms complete
end NFB_RowG

import NEW_GeometryPolynomial
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_MulDischarge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1

/-- Every raw scalar operand is admitted. The complete emitted operation
returns ok with precisely the natural-number product specification and a
canonical reply. This discharges the local ordered-log product abstraction. -/
theorem multiplication (left right : U32) :
    ∃ reply : U32,
      NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.mul left right=ok reply ∧
      reply.val=(left.val*right.val)%2147483647 ∧ reply.val<2147483647 := by
 obtain ⟨reply,run,value,canonical⟩ := ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod left right
 exact ⟨reply,(NEW_GeometryArithmetic.multiply_probe left right).trans run,value,canonical⟩

/-- The caller's only numeric restriction on its arbitrary native product
reply is supplied by the operation above, for all possible raw line words. -/
theorem caller_product_domain (line : U32) :
    ∃ reply : U32,
      NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.mul line line=ok reply ∧
      reply.val<2147483647 := by
 obtain ⟨reply,run,_,canonical⟩ := multiplication line line
 exact ⟨reply,run,canonical⟩

/-- Reuse NEW's contextual substitution; the downstream double/subtract
preconditions are derived from the SAME saved product, never caller premises. -/
theorem row_continuation {T : Type} (line : U32) (k : U32 → Result T) :
 (do let p ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.mul line line
     let d ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.double p
     let z ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.sub d NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
     k z) =
 (do let p ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul line line
     let d ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double p
     let z ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub d 1#u32
     k z) := NEW_GeometryPolynomial.continuation line k

#print axioms multiplication
#print axioms caller_product_domain
#print axioms row_continuation
end NFB_MulDischarge

 let p ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x x
 let d ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.double p
 NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.sub d NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE

def cohort (x : U32) : Result U32 := do
 let p ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul x x

 AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub d 1#u32

import NEF_FrozenInvRef.Funs
import NBG_InverseBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NET_MultiplyBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1

/-- The independently emitted checked reducer equals the coherent release
reducer on every raw U64. Its folds fit; no concrete large reduction is run. -/
theorem reducer (x : U64) :
 NEF_FrozenInvRef.field.reduce_u64 x = FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x := by
 let m := FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)
 have small : m.val < 4294967294 := by
  rw [LPf_ReductionWord.twice_value]
  apply LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt
  scalar_tac
 have mask : UScalar.cast .U64 (2147483647#u32) = 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
 unfold NEF_FrozenInvRef.field.reduce_u64 FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64
 simp only [NEF_FrozenInvRef.field.P,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok,
  mask,FIo_ReduceFacts.shr31]
 rw [FIo_ReduceBounds.checked x]
 simp only [bind_tc_ok]
 rw [FIo_ReduceBounds.checked (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)]
 simp only [bind_tc_ok]
 change (if UScalar.cast .U32 m >= 2147483647#u32
   then UScalar.cast .U32 m - 2147483647#u32 else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m)) =
  (if UScalar.cast .U32 m >= 2147483647#u32
   then ok (U32.wrapping_sub (UScalar.cast .U32 m) 2147483647#u32) else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m))
 split
 · apply FIo_ScalarBridge.sub
   scalar_tac
 · rfl

/-- Full raw U32 domain, including the actual checked product and Result. -/
theorem product (x y : U32) :
 NEF_FrozenInvRef.field.M31.mul x y = FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y := by
 have bound : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val * (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val < UScalar.size .U64 := by
  have h := LPf_BaseMultiply.product_bound x y
  have cx : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val=x.val := by scalar_tac
  have cy : (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val=y.val := by scalar_tac
  rw [cx,cy]
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits]
  exact h
 have native := FIo_ScalarBridge.mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y) bound
 simp only [NEF_FrozenInvRef.field.M31.mul,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul,
  lift,bind_tc_ok,native,reducer]
 rfl

/-- Paired meaning for each of the four product replies in the adopted CM
seven-call log; the caller must still establish its other child domains. -/
theorem product_reply (x y : U32) : ∃ z,
 NEF_FrozenInvRef.field.M31.mul x y=ok z ∧
 z.val=(x.val*y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val<2147483647 := by
 rw [product]
 exact LPf_BaseMultiply.source x y

#print axioms reducer
#print axioms product
#print axioms product_reply
end NET_MultiplyBridge

import LPf_CoreReduction
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_BaseMultiply
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Full u32 operands, without a canonical-input restriction. -/
theorem product_bound (x y : U32) : x.val * y.val < 18446744073709551616 := by
  have hx : x.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have hy : y.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have bound := Nat.mul_le_mul hx hy
  omega

theorem word_product (x y : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y)).val = x.val*y.val := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
  have cx : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by scalar_tac
  have cy : (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val = y.val := by scalar_tac
  rw [cx, cy]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits]
  exact product_bound x y

/-- The actual extracted frozen M31 multiplication is total and equals
natural multiplication modulo P. This is a Lean source theorem, not a claim
that the timed-out Kani exact contract passed. -/
theorem source (x y : U32) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val*y.val) % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨z, run, val, canonical⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y))
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, canonical⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul,lift,bind_tc_ok,run]
  · rw [word_product] at val
    exact val

#print axioms product_bound
#print axioms word_product
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPf_BaseMultiply

namespace AspisR1.LPf_CoreReduction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The two frozen source reducers place the u32 cast on opposite sides of
subtraction. Their twice-folded bounds make those placements equivalent. -/
theorem same (x : U64) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x =
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce x := by
  let m := FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)
  have small : m.val < 4294967294 := by
    rw [LPf_ReductionWord.twice_value]
    apply LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt
    scalar_tac
  have cv : (UScalar.cast .U32 m).val = m.val := by scalar_tac
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P,
    lift, bind_tc_ok]
  change (if UScalar.cast .U32 m ≥ 2147483647#u32
    then ok (U32.wrapping_sub (UScalar.cast .U32 m) 2147483647#u32)
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m)) =
    (if m ≥ 2147483647#u64
    then ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (U64.wrapping_sub m 2147483647#u64))
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m))
  split
  · rename_i h
    have hm : m ≥ 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_pos hm]
    congr 1
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    unfold U32.wrapping_sub U64.wrapping_sub
    rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq,
      UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
    norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
    omega
  · rename_i h
    have hm : ¬m ≥ 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_neg hm]

theorem source (x : U64) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  rw [same]
  exact LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce x

import FIo_ReduceBounds
import FIo_NativeFuns
import LPe_MersenneReduction
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_ReductionWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The native word fold has the natural value used in LPe's reduction theorem. -/
theorem fold_value (x : U64) :
    (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x).val = LPe_MersenneReduction.fold x.val :=
by
  unfold FIo_ReduceBounds.fold U64.wrapping_add
  rw [UScalar.wrapping_add_val_eq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (FIo_ReduceBounds.sum_bound x)]
  have low : (x &&& 2147483647#u64).val = x.val % 2147483648 := by
    change (x.bv &&& (2147483647 : BitVec 64)).toNat = x.val % 2147483648
    rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
    exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod x.val 31
  rw [low, FIo_ReduceBounds.shr_val]
  rfl

theorem twice_value (x : U64) :
    (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val =
      LPe_MersenneReduction.fold (LPe_MersenneReduction.fold x.val) := by
  rw [fold_value, fold_value]

/-- Exact value of the actual extracted private reducer, including word casts
and wrapping subtraction. No successful output observation is a premise. -/
theorem native_reduce (x : U64) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce x = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  have hx : x.val < 18446744073709551616 := by scalar_tac
  have small : (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val < 4294967294 := by
    rw [twice_value]
    exact LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt x.val hx
  have value := twice_value x
  have residue := LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce_eq_mod x.val hx
  unfold FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
  simp only [FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P, lift, bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x) ≥ 2147483647#u64
    then ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (U64.wrapping_sub
      (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)) 2147483647#u64))
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)))) = ok z ∧ _
  split
  · rename_i h
    have lower : 2147483647 ≤ (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold U64.wrapping_sub
      rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      unfold LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce at residue
      rw [if_pos (by omega)] at residue
      omega
    · unfold U64.wrapping_sub

NP6_StdModel.source:
import ClaimsUnrolledFinish

/-! Safe owned-reference std interpretation. The reserve result is the existing
allocator outcome, not an assumption of successful Claims. This module proves
value content laws only; P6 must connect shipped unsafe construction to this
reference before any native ledger row can be removed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NP6_StdModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev ReserveError := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.alloc.collections.TryReserveError
abbrev Reservation := core.result.Result Unit ReserveError

def calls (reservation : Reservation) : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls where
  reserve := fun _ before _ => ok (reservation,before)
  intoBox := fun _ before => ok before.deref

theorem reserve_contents (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (n : Usize) (result : Reservation)
    (after : alloc.vec.Vec T)
    (returned : (calls reservation).reserve A before n = ok (result,after)) :
    after = before ∧ result = reservation := by
  cases returned
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem box_contents (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (after : Slice T)
    (returned : (calls reservation).intoBox A before = ok after) :
    after.val = before.val := by
  cases returned
  rfl

theorem returning_nonvacuity {T : Type} (A : Type) (before : alloc.vec.Vec T)
    (n : Usize) :
    (calls (.Ok ())).reserve A before n = ok (.Ok (),before) ∧
    (calls (.Ok ())).intoBox A before = ok before.deref := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem error_contents (error : ReserveError) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (n : Usize) :
    (calls (.Err error)).reserve A before n = ok (.Err error,before) := rfl

#print axioms reserve_contents
#print axioms box_contents
#print axioms returning_nonvacuity
#print axioms error_contents
end AspisR1.NP6_StdModel
end

import ClaimsUnrolledParentRows
import S1ExtractedRoundChildrenV1
import S1SemanticFinishBoundsV1

/-! Install the complete emitted finite Claims VALUE interpretation in the
actual S1 finish consumer. Source getters and the existing full indexed decoder
are fixed. Native reserve/box ownership/error/cleanup/effect correspondence and
candidate adoption remain open; this file does not assert them as std trust.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledFinish
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev ParentQM := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev MainQM := AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev ParentError := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainError := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainPrefix := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix
abbrev MainRecord := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord
abbrev MainClaims := Array (Array MainQM 29#usize) 3#usize

/-- Two unresolved operational placeholders in this VALUE interpretation.
No successful allocation, zero content, frame or Claims postcondition occurs
in this dictionary. Their actual-runtime instance is NOT proved here. The
explicit mapError/boxArray value models ALSO retain their native std,
ownership/error/abort/cleanup/effect correspondence obligations. -/
structure StdCalls where
  reserve : {T : Type} → (A : Type) → alloc.vec.Vec T → Usize →
    Result ((core.result.Result Unit AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.alloc.collections.TryReserveError) × alloc.vec.Vec T)
  intoBox : {T : Type} → (A : Type) → alloc.vec.Vec T → Result (Slice T)

def fromMainError : MainError → ParentError
  | .Allocation  => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow  => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal  => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints  => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes  => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public  => .Public

def toMainError : ParentError → MainError
  | .Allocation  => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow  => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal  => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints  => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes  => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public  => .Public

def fromMainQM (q : MainQM) : ParentQM := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def toMainQM (q : ParentQM) : MainQM := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def fromMainArray {n : Usize} (a : Array MainQM n) : Array ParentQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map fromMainQM,by simpa using a.property⟩
def toMainArray {n : Usize} (a : Array ParentQM n) : Array MainQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map toMainQM,by simpa using a.property⟩
def fromMainPrefix (p : MainPrefix) : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix :=
  ⟨p.c1_root,p.records⟩
def toMainPrefix (p : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix) : MainPrefix :=
  ⟨p.c1_root,p.records⟩
def toMainRecord (r : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord) : MainRecord :=
  ⟨r.row,r.framed⟩

def sourceRecord (p : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix) (row : U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord ParentError) :=
  match AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record (toMainPrefix p) row with
  | .ok (.Ok r) => .ok (.Ok ⟨r.row,r.framed⟩)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (fromMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

/-- Actual complete indexed decode_k body already selected by S1, including
all errors and ambient fail/div. No chosen decoder outcome is a parameter. -/
def sourceDecode (n : Usize) (r : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord)
    (offset : Usize) : Result (core.result.Result (Array ParentQM n) ParentError) :=
  match AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren.decodeMain n (toMainRecord r) offset with
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok (fromMainArray a))
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (fromMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def external (std : StdCalls) : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.External :=
  {reserve := std.reserve, intoBox := std.intoBox,
   validated := sourceRecord, decode := sourceDecode}

def toMainStatus :
    Result (core.result.Result AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.Claims ParentError) →
      Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok ⟨a.val.map toMainArray,by simpa using a.property⟩)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (toMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def claims (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) : Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError) :=
  toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.candidate_claims.claims (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

def reference (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) : Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError) :=
  toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.claimsReference (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

/-- Complete parent refinement with actual source getter/decoder installed.
No assertion about native allocation/cleanup or candidate adoption is added. -/
theorem claims_value (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) :
    claims std pre = reference std pre :=
  congrArg toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.claims_value (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

def install (std : StdCalls) (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries := {B with claims := claims std}

/-- Actual whole-finish success supplies this SAME Claims execution. No
separate accepted Claims equation, initialized storage or chosen rows premise.
All other finish children, native/std/refinement and release gates remain. -/
theorem finish_claims
    (std : StdCalls) (R : AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (pre : MainPrefix) (before : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (challenges : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Challenges)
    (obs : Option (AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (accepted : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.finish R (install std B)
      D pub pre before challenges obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    reference std pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) := by
  obtain ⟨running,t25,record25,record26,z0,t26,z1,t27,
      rounds,challenge,state,transcript,called,rest⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds.finish_success R (install std B)
      D pub pre before challenges obs out accepted
  change claims std pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) at called
  rw [claims_value] at called
  exact called

#print axioms claims_value
#print axioms finish_claims
end AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledFinish
end

import ExtractedSemanticRoundsModel
import AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.Funs
import AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev MainQM := AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev GenQM := AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev DecodeQM := AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev DecodeRecord := AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord
abbrev DecodeError := AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainRecord := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord
abbrev MainError := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Error

def recordToDecoder (r : MainRecord) : DecodeRecord := ⟨r.row, r.framed⟩

def decoderQMToMain (q : DecodeQM) : MainQM :=
  ⟨⟨q.c0.a, q.c0.b⟩, ⟨q.c1.a, q.c1.b⟩⟩

def decoderArrayToMain {n : Usize} (a : Array DecodeQM n) : Array MainQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map decoderQMToMain, by simpa using a.property⟩

def decoderErrorToMain : DecodeError → MainError
  | .Allocation => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public => .Public

def decoderResultToMain (n : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array DecodeQM n) DecodeError) →
      Result (core.result.Result (Array MainQM n) MainError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok (decoderArrayToMain a))
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (decoderErrorToMain e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

/-- A nominal adapter around the pinned actual indexed decode_k body. -/
def decodeMain (n : Usize) (r : MainRecord) (offset : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array MainQM n) MainError) :=
  decoderResultToMain n
    (AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k n (recordToDecoder r) offset)


def mainToGen (q : MainQM) : GenQM :=
  ⟨⟨q.c0.a, q.c0.b⟩, ⟨q.c1.a, q.c1.b⟩⟩

def genToMain (q : GenQM) : MainQM :=
  ⟨⟨q.c0.a, q.c0.b⟩, ⟨q.c1.a, q.c1.b⟩⟩

def mainArrayToGen (xs : Array MainQM 28#usize) : Array GenQM 28#usize :=
  ⟨xs.val.map mainToGen, by simpa using xs.property⟩

def mainAlphaArrayToGen (xs : Array MainQM 10#usize) : Array GenQM 10#usize :=
  ⟨xs.val.map mainToGen, by simpa using xs.property⟩

def genResultToMain : Result GenQM → Result MainQM
  | .ok q => .ok (genToMain q)
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def generatedMainBoundary (coefficients : Array MainQM 28#usize) : Result MainQM :=
  genResultToMain (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_boundary_entry
    (mainArrayToGen coefficients))

def generatedMainValue (coefficients : Array MainQM 28#usize)
    (alpha : Array MainQM 10#usize) (round : Usize) : Result MainQM :=
  genResultToMain (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_value_entry
    (mainArrayToGen coefficients) (mainAlphaArrayToGen alpha) round)

def generatedRoundBoundaries
    (decodeMain : (N : Usize) → AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord → Usize →
      Result (core.result.Result (Array MainQM N) AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Error)) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries :=
  { decode := decodeMain
    boundary := generatedMainBoundary
    value := generatedMainValue }


/-- Full concrete extracted children. No child function remains a parameter.
Native fold control and parser/Rust/Std/abort interpretation retain their own
source pins and obligations; this definition does not assert that transport. -/
def children : AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries :=
  generatedRoundBoundaries decodeMain

theorem decode_exact (n : Usize) (r : MainRecord) (offset : Usize) :
    children.decode n r offset = decoderResultToMain n
      (AspisR1DecodeKFullV10.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.decode_k n (recordToDecoder r) offset) := rfl

theorem boundary_exact (p : Array MainQM 28#usize) :
    children.boundary p = genResultToMain
      (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_boundary_entry (mainArrayToGen p)) := rfl

theorem value_exact (p : Array MainQM 28#usize) (a : Array MainQM 10#usize) (round : Usize) :
    children.value p a round = genResultToMain
      (AspisR1SemanticCallExtraction.r1_semantic.semantic_value_entry
        (mainArrayToGen p) (mainAlphaArrayToGen a) round) := rfl

theorem coordinates_roundtrip (q : MainQM) : genToMain (mainToGen q) = q := by
  cases q with
  | mk c0 c1 => cases c0; cases c1; rfl

theorem preserve_failure (e : Error) :
    genResultToMain (.fail e) = .fail e := rfl

theorem preserve_divergence : genResultToMain .div = .div := rfl

#print axioms decode_exact
#print axioms boundary_exact
#print axioms value_exact
#print axioms coordinates_roundtrip
#print axioms preserve_failure
#print axioms preserve_divergence
end AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren

import S1SemanticFinishModelV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
private theorem pair_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok p => cases p with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- Actual complete finish success reaches its fixed actual rounds and both
source circle steps; returned alpha/challenges/state/transcript are those same
values. No rounds/circle/terminal child-success premise is assumed. -/
theorem finish_success (R : RoundModel.Boundaries) (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public) (pre : r1_wire.Prefix)
    (before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (challenges : r1_wire.Challenges)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (h : FinishModel.finish R B D pub pre before challenges obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ running t25 record25 record26 z0 t26 z1 t27,
      RoundModel.rounds R D pre before = ok (.Ok (running,out.alpha,t25)) ∧
      out.challenges = challenges ∧ out.state_before_z0 = t25.state ∧ out.transcript = t27 ∧
      B.claims pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) ∧
      r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record pre 25#u8 = ok (.Ok record25) ∧
      R.decode 29#usize record25 87#usize = ok (.Ok out.extra) ∧
      FinishModel.circle_validated B D t25 record25 = ok (.Ok z0,t26) ∧
      r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record pre 26#u8 = ok (.Ok record26) ∧
      R.decode 29#usize record26 0#usize = ok (.Ok out.before_z1) ∧
      FinishModel.circle_validated B D t26 record26 = ok (.Ok z1,t27) ∧
      out.z = Array.make 2#usize [z0,z1] := by
  unfold FinishModel.finish at h
  obtain ⟨roundsResult, hrounds, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases roundsResult with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases h
  | Ok val =>
    rcases val with ⟨running,alpha,t25⟩
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
    obtain ⟨claimsResult,hclaims,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases claimsResult with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok claims =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨terminalResult,hterminal,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases terminalResult with
      | Err e =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,FinishModel.closureFn11,FinishModel.closureFn10,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
          core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
        cases h
      | Ok terminal =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
        obtain ⟨mask16,hm16,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨mask10,hm10,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨claim0,hc0,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨claim27,hc27,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨mask,hm,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨record25Result,hr25,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        cases record25Result with
        | Err e =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
            core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
          cases h
        | Ok record25 =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
          obtain ⟨extraResult,hextra,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
          cases extraResult with
          | Err e =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
              core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
            cases h
          | Ok extra =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
            obtain ⟨etaTerminal,het,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨masked,hmasked,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨extra28,he28,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨maskedTerminal,hmt,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨different,hdiff,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            cases different with
            | true => cases h
            | false =>
              simp only [VerifyPrefix.mark,r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state,
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
              obtain ⟨circle0Result,t26,hz0,h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
              cases circle0Result with
              | Err e =>
                simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                  core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                  core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                cases h
              | Ok z0 =>
                simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                obtain ⟨record26Result,hr26,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                cases record26Result with
                | Err e =>
                  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                    core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                  cases h
                | Ok record26 =>
                  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                  obtain ⟨beforeZ1Result,hbeforeZ1,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                  cases beforeZ1Result with
                  | Err e =>
                    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                      core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                    cases h
                  | Ok beforeZ1 =>
                    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                    obtain ⟨circle1Result,t27,hz1,h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
                    cases circle1Result with
                    | Err e =>
                      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                        core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                      cases h
                    | Ok z1 =>
                      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
                      obtain ⟨equal,hequal,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                      cases equal with
                      | true => cases h
                      | false =>
                        obtain ⟨rootResult,hroot,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                        cases rootResult with
                        | Err e =>
                          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                            core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                          cases h
                        | Ok rootPayload =>
                          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                          obtain ⟨copied,hcopy,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                          obtain ⟨root2,hroot2,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                          have he := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
                          cases he
                          exact ⟨running,t25,record25,record26,z0,t26,z1,t27,
                            hrounds,rfl,rfl,rfl,hclaims,hr25,hextra,hz0,hr26,hbeforeZ1,hz1,rfl⟩

#print axioms finish_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds

import ExtractedSemanticRoundsModel
import S1SemanticPrefixModelV1
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation
inductive FinishModel.CircleRow where
| First : FinishModel.CircleRow
| Second : FinishModel.CircleRow

def FinishModel.CircleRow.read_discriminant : FinishModel.CircleRow → Isize
  | .First => 0#isize
  | .Second => 1#isize
instance _root_.AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.CircleRow.instDiscriminant :
    Aeneas.Std.Discriminant FinishModel.CircleRow Isize where
  read_discriminant := FinishModel.CircleRow.read_discriminant

@[reducible]
def FinishModel.Closure2 (H : Type) :=
  Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize

@[reducible]
def FinishModel.Closure1 (H : Type) :=
  Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize

@[reducible]
def FinishModel.Closure (H : Type) := Unit

structure FinishModel.Boundaries where
  fromFn : {T F : Type} → (N : Usize) → core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T → F → Result (Array T N)
  mask : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 16#usize → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize →
    aspis_core.field.QM31 → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize → Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  add : aspis_core.field.QM31 → aspis_core.field.QM31 → Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  mul : aspis_core.field.QM31 → aspis_core.field.QM31 → Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  terminal : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public →
    Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize →
    r1_wire.Challenges → Result (core.result.Result aspis_core.field.QM31 aspis_core.state_only_prefix.r0.Error)
  circle : Array U8 32#usize → FinishModel.CircleRow → Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint
  unwrapRoot : core.result.Result (Array U8 32#usize) core.array.TryFromSliceError → Result (Array U8 32#usize)
  claims : r1_wire.Prefix → Result (core.result.Result (Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize) r1_wire.Error)
def FinishModel.payload
  (self : r1_wire.Prefix) (row : Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Slice Std.U8) r1_wire.Error)
  := do
  let r ← r1_wire.Prefix.record self row
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let s ←
      core.slice.index.Slice.index
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) val
        { start := 5#usize }
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok s)
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (Slice Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error) residual

def
  FinishModel.pointEq
  (self : aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint)
  (other : aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) :
  Result Bool
  := do
  let b ← aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31.eq self.x other.x
  if b
  then aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31.eq self.y other.y
  else ok false

def FinishModel.circle_validated (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (self : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (record1 : r1_wire.ValidatedRecord) :
  Result ((core.result.Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint
    r1_wire.Error) × (r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H))
  := do
  let row ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.row record1
  match row with
  | 25#uscalar =>
    let s ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.framed record1
    let (r, self1) ←
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated aspis_coreDigest32Inst
        self 25#u8 s
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let scp ← B.circle val FinishModel.CircleRow.First
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok scp, self1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame
          r1_wire.Error) residual
      ok (r1, self1)
  | 26#uscalar =>
    let s ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.framed record1
    let (r, self1) ←
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated aspis_coreDigest32Inst
        self 26#u8 s
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let scp ← B.circle val FinishModel.CircleRow.Second
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok scp, self1)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      let r1 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame
          r1_wire.Error) residual
      ok (r1, self1)
  | _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.InvalidRow, self)

def
  FinishModel.closureFn2
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (c : FinishModel.Closure2 H) (tupled_args : Std.Usize) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.QM31 × (FinishModel.Closure2 H))
  := do
  let i ← 16#usize + tupled_args
  let a ← Array.index_usize c 0#usize
  let q ← Array.index_usize a i
  ok (q, c)

def
  FinishModel.closureFn3
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (c : FinishModel.Closure2 H) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  := do
  let (q, _) ←
    FinishModel.closureFn2
      aspis_coreDigest32Inst c i
  ok q

@[reducible]
def
  FinishModel.closureFn4
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H) :
  core.ops.function.FnOnce (FinishModel.Closure2 H) Std.Usize
  aspis_core.field.QM31 := {
  call_once :=
    FinishModel.closureFn3
    aspis_coreDigest32Inst
}

@[reducible]
def
  FinishModel.closureFn5
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H) :
  core.ops.function.FnMut (FinishModel.Closure2 H) Std.Usize
  aspis_core.field.QM31 := {
  FnOnceInst :=
    FinishModel.closureFn4
    aspis_coreDigest32Inst
  call_mut :=
    FinishModel.closureFn2
    aspis_coreDigest32Inst
}

def
  FinishModel.closureFn6
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (c : FinishModel.Closure1 H) (tupled_args : Std.Usize) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.QM31 × (FinishModel.Closure1 H))
  := do
  let a ← Array.index_usize c 0#usize
  let q ← Array.index_usize a tupled_args
  ok (q, c)

def
  FinishModel.closureFn7
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (c : FinishModel.Closure1 H) (i : Std.Usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  := do
  let (q, _) ←
    FinishModel.closureFn6
      aspis_coreDigest32Inst c i
  ok q

@[reducible]
def
  FinishModel.closureFn8
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H) :

import NEB_TableCalls

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEB_GeometryFieldPorts
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1QueryGeometryActual LPi_FieldValues

theorem add (x y : U32) (hx : x.val<2147483647) (hy : y.val<2147483647) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.add x y := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,_⟩ := LPi_NatBase.add x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,_⟩ := ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod x y hx hy
  have same : a=b := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (va.trans vb.symm)
  rw [ha,hb,same]

theorem sub (x y : U32) (hx : x.val<2147483647) (hy : y.val<2147483647) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub x y := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,_⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,_⟩ := ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod x y hx hy
  have same : a=b := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (va.trans vb.symm)
  rw [ha,hb,same]

theorem double (x : U32) (hx : x.val<2147483647) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.double x=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double x := by
  exact add x x hx hx

/-- Instantiate the ACTUAL adopted geometry dictionary, not only a new emitted
field dictionary with similar field names. -/
theorem physical : NEA_PointComplete.PhysicalInterpretation R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ => rfl,?_⟩
  intro x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨z,run,cz,real,imag⟩ := ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.current_mul_words
    (R17CurrentCM31Semantics.toArithmetic x) (R17CurrentCM31Semantics.toArithmetic y) hx hy
  refine ⟨R17CurrentCM31Semantics.fromArithmetic z,?_,cz,?_⟩
  · simp only [R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations,run,bind_tc_ok]
  · apply Prod.ext
    · simpa only [R17CurrentCM31Semantics.fromArithmetic,R17CurrentCM31Semantics.toArithmetic,
        LPi_FieldValues.mulC,LPi_CMProduct.realWord,ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.realWord] using real
    · simpa only [R17CurrentCM31Semantics.fromArithmetic,R17CurrentCM31Semantics.toArithmetic,
        LPi_FieldValues.mulC,LPi_CMProduct.imagWord,ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.imagWord] using imag

theorem cm_eq (x y : field.CM31) (hx : NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical x) (hy : NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical y) :
    R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations.mul x y=NEA_FieldProduct.ops.mul x y := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,_,va⟩ := physical.multiply x y hx hy
  obtain ⟨b,hb,_,vb⟩ := NEA_PointComplete.emitted_interpretation.multiply x y hx hy
  have values : (a.a.val,a.b.val)=(b.a.val,b.b.val) := va.trans vb.symm
  have ae : a.a=b.a := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (congrArg Prod.fst values)
  have be : a.b=b.b := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (congrArg Prod.snd values)
  have same : a=b := by cases a;cases b;simp_all
  rw [ha,hb,same]

def fromPublic (x : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.CM31) : field.CM31 := ⟨x.a,x.b⟩

/-- Actual emitted constructor, both full raw words, and the exact table-call
carrier. No canonicality or successful-child premise is introduced. -/
theorem constructor (a b : U32) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.CM31.new a b=ok ⟨a,b⟩ ∧
    NEA_FieldProduct.ops.new a b=ok ⟨a,b⟩ ∧
    (do let x ← AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.CM31.new a b
        ok (fromPublic x))=NEA_FieldProduct.ops.new a b := by
  exact ⟨NBG_Constructors.cm31_new a b,rfl,by rw [NBG_Constructors.cm31_new];rfl⟩

theorem table_body (a b : U32) :
    fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops (a,b)=NEA_FieldProduct.ops.new a b ∧
    fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops (a,b)=ok ⟨a,b⟩ := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

/-- The selected old table packet's dictionary and the point packet's emitted
field dictionary agree on this ACTUAL constructor call; multiplication unused. -/
theorem selected_table (v : U32 × U32) :
    (do let w ← NDH_Reference.table_ref v;ok (field.CM31.mk w.1 w.2))=
      fast_domain.table_value R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations v ∧
    fast_domain.table_value R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations v=
      fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops v := by
  rcases v with ⟨a,b⟩
  exact ⟨NDH_Geometry.table _ (fun _ _ => rfl) _,rfl⟩

theorem constructor_frame {S Event : Type} (state : S) (a b : U32) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.CM31.new a b=ok ⟨a,b⟩ ∧
    NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.CM31.new a b)=ok (⟨a,b⟩,state,[]) :=
  ⟨NBG_Constructors.cm31_new a b,NEB_PureFrame.successful state _ _ (NBG_Constructors.cm31_new a b)⟩

theorem table_frame {S Event : Type} (state : S) (v : U32 × U32) :
    fast_domain.table_value R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations v=ok ⟨v.1,v.2⟩ ∧
    fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops v=ok ⟨v.1,v.2⟩ ∧
    NDH_Reference.table_ref v=ok v ∧
    NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
      (fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops v)=ok (⟨v.1,v.2⟩,state,[]) := by
  cases v with
  | mk a b => exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,NEB_PureFrame.successful state _ _ rfl⟩

theorem getter_frame {S Event : Type} (state : S) (u : Usize) (admitted : u.val<262144) :
