import NEA_PointComplete
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEB_PointCalls
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1QueryGeometryActual

/-- The callee's non-root physical interpretation is instantiated, not retained. -/
theorem canonical_point (u : Usize) (admitted : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ p : domain.Point field.M31,
      fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u=ok p ∧
      p.x.val<2147483647 ∧ p.y.val<2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,z,canonical,_,_,point⟩ :=
    NEA_PointComplete.cohort NEA_FieldProduct.ops NEA_PointComplete.emitted_interpretation u admitted
  exact ⟨⟨z.a,z.b⟩,point,canonical.1,canonical.2⟩

/-- Exact selected operands establish the lower CM31 packet at this call. -/
theorem selected_product (u : Usize) (admitted : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ (iA iB : Usize) (a b : U32 × U32) (z : field.CM31),
      lift (u &&& 511#usize)=ok iA ∧ u >>> 9#i32=ok iB ∧
      Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_A iA=ok a ∧
      Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_B iB=ok b ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.ops.mul ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩=ok z ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical z ∧
      fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u=ok ⟨z.a,z.b⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨ix,iA,iB,a,b,get,same,mask,lo,shift,hi,readA,readB⟩ :=
    R17FibrePointActualSuccess.source_indices_and_table_reads u admitted
  have eq : ix=u := (Result.ok.inj get).symm
  subst ix
  have low : iA.val<512 := by rw [lo]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have high : iB.val<512 := by rw [hi]; unfold NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain at admitted; omega
  have ca := NEA_TableCanonical.readA iA low a readA
  have cb := NEA_TableCanonical.readB iB high b readB
  obtain ⟨z,product,cz,_⟩ := NEA_PointComplete.emitted_interpretation.multiply
    ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ ca cb
  have selected := NEA_PointBridge.selected NEA_FieldProduct.ops u iA iB a b z
    mask shift readA readB NEA_PointComplete.emitted_interpretation.constructor product
  exact ⟨iA,iB,a,b,z,mask,shift,readA,readB,ca,cb,product,cz,selected.2⟩

def pureState {A S Event : Type} (s : S) (r : Result A) : Result (A × S × List Event) := do
  let z ← r
  ok (z,s,[])

/-- The emitted field/table operations are pure; the native bridge separately
certifies its ghost-only frame. This lift is not a native evaluator. -/
theorem state_effects {S Event : Type} (s : S) (u : Usize)
    (admitted : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ p : domain.Point field.M31,
      pureState (Event:=Event) s (fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u)=ok (p,s,[]) ∧
      p.x.val<2147483647 ∧ p.y.val<2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨p,run,cx,cy⟩ := canonical_point u admitted
  exact ⟨p,by simp only [pureState,run,bind_tc_ok],cx,cy⟩

#print axioms canonical_point
#print axioms selected_product
#print axioms state_effects
end NEB_PointCalls

NEA_PointComplete.source:
import NEA_TableCanonical
import NEA_PointBridge
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEA_PointComplete
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1QueryGeometryActual
open AspisR1.LPi_FieldValues NEA_FieldProduct

/-- Lower native CM31 bridge interpretation only. No geometry result or
successful enclosing call is a field. NBG/LPi supply this canonical law. -/
structure PhysicalInterpretation (cm : CM31Ops) : Prop where
  constructor : ∀ a b, cm.new a b=ok ⟨a,b⟩
  multiply : ∀ x y, Canonical x → Canonical y →
    ∃ z, cm.mul x y=ok z ∧ Canonical z ∧
      (z.a.val,z.b.val)=mulC (x.a.val,x.b.val) (y.a.val,y.b.val)

theorem emitted_interpretation : PhysicalInterpretation NEA_FieldProduct.ops :=
  ⟨fun _ _ => rfl,NEA_FieldProduct.geometric_cm⟩

theorem cohort (cm : CM31Ops) (physical : PhysicalInterpretation cm)
    (u : Usize) (admitted : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ (a b : U32 × U32) (z : field.CM31),
      Canonical z ∧
      (z.a.val,z.b.val)=mulC (a.1.val,a.2.val) (b.1.val,b.2.val) ∧
      NEA_PointParam.point_ref u fast_domain.TABLE_A fast_domain.TABLE_B
        (Array.make 2#usize [z.a,z.b])=ok (NEA_PointBridge.record a b z) ∧
      fast_domain.fibre_point cm u=ok ⟨z.a,z.b⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨ix,iA,iB,a,b,get,same,mask,lo,shift,hi,readA,readB⟩ :=
    R17FibrePointActualSuccess.source_indices_and_table_reads u admitted
  have eq : ix=u := (Result.ok.inj get).symm
  subst ix
  have low : iA.val < 512 := by rw [lo]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have high : iB.val < 512 := by rw [hi]; unfold NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain at admitted; omega
  have ca := NEA_TableCanonical.readA iA low a readA
  have cb := NEA_TableCanonical.readB iB high b readB
  obtain ⟨z,product,canonical,value⟩ := physical.multiply ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ ca cb
  have both := NEA_PointBridge.selected cm u iA iB a b z mask shift readA readB
    physical.constructor product
  exact ⟨a,b,z,canonical,value,both.1,both.2⟩

#print axioms emitted_interpretation
#print axioms cohort
end NEA_PointComplete

import NEA_PointParam.Funs
import NEA_FieldProduct
import R17FibrePointActualSuccess
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEA_PointBridge
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1QueryGeometryActual

def PacketDomain (u : Usize) : Prop := u.val < 262144

def record (a b : U32 × U32) (z : field.CM31) : Array U32 6#usize :=
  Array.make 6#usize [a.1,a.2,b.1,b.2,z.a,z.b]

/-- Reference-to-cohort association at the exact selected table inputs.
The product run is the named LOWER CM31 callee boundary, not a fibre-point
success premise. Canonical natural products are supplied by emitted_cm. -/
theorem selected (ops : CM31Ops) (u iA iB : Usize) (a b : U32 × U32)
    (z : field.CM31)
    (mask : lift (u &&& 511#usize)=ok iA)
    (shift : u >>> 9#i32=ok iB)
    (readA : Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_A iA=ok a)
    (readB : Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_B iB=ok b)
    (constructor : ∀ x y, ops.new x y=ok ⟨x,y⟩)
    (product : ops.mul ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩=ok z) :
    NEA_PointParam.point_ref u fast_domain.TABLE_A fast_domain.TABLE_B
        (Array.make 2#usize [z.a,z.b])=ok (record a b z) ∧
    fast_domain.fibre_point ops u=ok ⟨z.a,z.b⟩ := by
  rcases a with ⟨a0,a1⟩
  rcases b with ⟨b0,b1⟩
  constructor
  · simp only [NEA_PointParam.point_ref,mask,shift,readA,readB,bind_tc_ok]
    simp [Array.index_usize,Array.make,record]
  · simp only [fast_domain.fibre_point,domain.FibreIndex.get,mask,shift,
      readA,readB,fast_domain.table_value,constructor,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do let point ← ops.mul ⟨a0,a1⟩ ⟨b0,b1⟩
               ok ({x:=point.a,y:=point.b} : domain.Point field.M31)) = _
    rw [product]
    rfl

/-- Every admitted index determines both reads, without assuming a successful
geometry computation. Native K010 supplies the canonical selected table data;
only the lower product interpretation is then required. -/
theorem reads (u : Usize) (admitted : PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ iA iB a b,
      lift (u &&& 511#usize)=ok iA ∧ u >>> 9#i32=ok iB ∧
      Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_A iA=ok a ∧
      Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_B iB=ok b := by
  obtain ⟨ix,iA,iB,a,b,get,same,mask,_,shift,_,readA,readB⟩ :=
    R17FibrePointActualSuccess.source_indices_and_table_reads u admitted
  have eq : ix=u := by simpa [domain.FibreIndex.get] using (Result.ok.inj get).symm
  subst ix
  exact ⟨iA,iB,a,b,mask,shift,readA,readB⟩

#print axioms selected
#print axioms reads
end NEA_PointBridge

import NDH_Geometry
import LPi_FieldValues
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEA_FieldProduct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1.LPi_FieldValues
abbrev GC := AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.field.CM31
def toNative (x : GC) : NC := ⟨x.a,x.b⟩
def ofNative (x : NC) : GC := ⟨x.a,x.b⟩
def Canonical (x : GC) : Prop := x.a.val < 2147483647 ∧ x.b.val < 2147483647

def ops : AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.CM31Ops :=
  ⟨fun a b => ok ⟨a,b⟩, fun x y => do
    let z ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul (toNative x) (toNative y)
    ok (ofNative z)⟩

theorem emitted_cm (x y : GC) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul (toNative x) (toNative y)=ok z ∧
      canonC z ∧ cw z=mulC (cw (toNative x)) (cw (toNative y)) := by
  exact AspisR1.LPi_FieldValues.cm_mul (toNative x) (toNative y) hx hy

theorem geometric_cm (x y : GC) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    ∃ z, ops.mul x y=ok z ∧ Canonical z ∧
      (z.a.val,z.b.val)=mulC (x.a.val,x.b.val) (y.a.val,y.b.val) := by
  obtain ⟨z,run,canonical,value⟩ := emitted_cm x y hx hy
  refine ⟨ofNative z,?_,canonical,value⟩
  simp only [ops,run,bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms emitted_cm
#print axioms geometric_cm
end NEA_FieldProduct

def subC (a b : CW) : CW := (subM a.1 b.1,subM a.2 b.2)
def mulC (a b : CW) : CW := (LPi_CMProduct.realWord a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2,
  LPi_CMProduct.imagWord a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2)
def byR (a : CW) : CW := (subM (addM a.1 a.1) a.2,addM a.1 (addM a.2 a.2))

  let ac := mulC a.1 b.1
  let bd := mulC a.2 b.2
  let cross := mulC (addC a.1 a.2) (addC b.1 b.2)
  (addC ac (byR bd),subC (subC cross ac) bd)
def mulU (a : QW) : QW := (byR a.2,a.1)
def mulE (a b : EW) : EW :=
  let ac := mulQ a.1 b.1
  let bd := mulQ a.2 b.2
  let cross := mulQ (addQ a.1 a.2) (addQ b.1 b.2)
  (addQ ac (mulU bd),subQ (subQ cross ac) bd)

import LPi_NatBase
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_CMProduct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_Total
abbrev NC := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31

def Canon (x : NC) : Prop := x.a.val<2147483647 ∧ x.b.val<2147483647

def realWord (a b c d : Nat) := ((a*c)%2147483647+2147483647-(b*d)%2147483647)%2147483647
def imagWord (a b c d : Nat) :=
  ((((a+b)*(c+d))%2147483647+2147483647-(a*c)%2147483647)%2147483647+
    2147483647-(b*d)%2147483647)%2147483647

def sum (x : NC) : U64 := U64.wrapping_add
  (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x.a) (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x.b)
def cross (x y : NC) : U64 := U64.wrapping_mul (sum x) (sum y)

theorem sum_value (x : NC) : (sum x).val=x.a.val+x.b.val := by
  unfold sum
  rw [U64.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
  rfl

theorem cross_value (x y : NC) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) :
    (cross x y).val=(x.a.val+x.b.val)*(y.a.val+y.b.val) := by
  unfold cross
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq,sum_value,sum_value]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h0 : x.a.val+x.b.val < 4294967296 := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := hx; omega
  have h1 : y.a.val+y.b.val < 4294967296 := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := hy; omega
  have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt h0 h1
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits] at h ⊢
  exact h

theorem source (x y : NC) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y = ok z ∧ Canon z ∧
      z.a.val = realWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val ∧
      z.b.val = imagWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val := by
  obtain ⟨m0,h0,v0,c0⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x.a y.a
  obtain ⟨m1,h1,v1,c1⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x.b y.b
  obtain ⟨m2,h2,v2,c2⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source (cross x y)
  have hr : FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 (cross x y) = ok m2 := by
    simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64,h2,bind_tc_ok]
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,ca⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub m0 m1 c0 c1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,cb⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub m2 m0 c2 c0
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc,cc⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub b m1 cb c1
  refine ⟨⟨a,c⟩,?_,⟨ca,cc⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul,h0,h1,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do let t ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 (cross x y)
               let a ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub m0 m1
               let b ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub t m0
               let c ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub b m1
               ok (⟨a,c⟩ : NC)) = _
    simp only [hr,ha,hb,hc,bind_tc_ok]
  · simpa only [realWord,v0,v1] using va
  · rw [cross_value x y hx hy] at v2
    simpa only [imagWord,vb,v2,v0,v1] using vc

theorem sub_word (x y : U32) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) :
    (U32.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val-y.val := by
  rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have hx := x.hSize
  have hy := y.hSize
  have he : x.val+(UScalar.size .U32-y.val)=(x.val-y.val)+UScalar.size .U32 := by omega
  rw [he,Nat.add_mod,Nat.mod_self,Nat.add_zero,Nat.mod_mod,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

theorem add (x y : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) (hy : y.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val+y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  let s := U32.wrapping_add x y
  have sv : s.val = x.val+y.val := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if s ≥ 2147483647#u32 then
    ok (U32.wrapping_sub s 2147483647#u32) else ok s) = ok z ∧ _
  by_cases h : s ≥ 2147483647#u32
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hp : 2147483647 ≤ s.val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]
      change s.val-2147483647 = (x.val+y.val)%2147483647
      rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hp,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]; change s.val-2147483647 < 2147483647; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hp : s.val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac
    exact ⟨_,rfl,by rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp],hp⟩

theorem sub (x y : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) (hy : y.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val+2147483647-y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  let a := U32.wrapping_add x 2147483647#u32
  have av : a.val = x.val+2147483647 := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
    rfl
  let s := U32.wrapping_sub a y
  have sv : s.val = x.val+2147483647-y.val := by
    rw [sub_word _ _ (by omega),av]
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if s ≥ 2147483647#u32 then
    ok (U32.wrapping_sub s 2147483647#u32) else ok s) = ok z ∧ _
  by_cases h : s ≥ 2147483647#u32

    have hp : 2147483647 ≤ s.val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]
      change s.val-2147483647 = (x.val+2147483647-y.val)%2147483647
      rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hp,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]; change s.val-2147483647 < 2147483647; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hp : s.val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac

def Total {α : Type} (r : Result α) : Prop := ∃ z, r = ok z

theorem bind_total {α β : Type} {r : Result α} {k : α → Result β}
    (hr : Total r) (hk : ∀ x, Total (k x)) : Total (r >>= k) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hr
  rw [hx,bind_tc_ok]
  exact hk x

theorem m31_mul (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,_,_⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x y
  exact ⟨z,h⟩

theorem reduce (x : U64) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,_,_⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source x
  exact ⟨z,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64,h,bind_tc_ok]⟩

theorem m31_add (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y) := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem m31_sub (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y) := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_add (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub

  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro b

  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
  apply bind_total (m31_mul _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_mul _ _); intro b
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  apply bind_total (reduce _); intro c
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro d
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro e
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro f
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.double

  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro b
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro c
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro d
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem qm_add (x y : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add x y) := by

  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro d
  apply bind_total (cm_mul _ _); intro e
  apply bind_total (by_r _); intro f

import NEB_PointSuccess
import NEA_LineComplete
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEB_LineCalls
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1QueryGeometryActual
open AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)

/-- Every inner point/field domain is discharged by the SAME emitted path. -/
theorem admitted (u : Usize) (domain : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ (point : AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.domain.Point field.M31) (square out : U32),
      fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u=ok point ∧
      point.x.val<2147483647 ∧ point.y.val<2147483647 ∧
      AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul point.x point.x=ok square ∧
      square.val<2147483647 ∧
      NEA_Reference.line_double_sub_ref square=ok out ∧
      R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node NEA_FieldProduct.ops R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations u=ok out ∧
      out.val<2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨p,square,out,point,cx,cy,product,value,reference,line,co⟩ :=
    NEA_LineComplete.cohort NEA_FieldProduct.ops NEA_PointComplete.emitted_interpretation u domain
  obtain ⟨s,run,_,cs⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod p.x p.x
  have same : s=square := Result.ok.inj (run.symm.trans product)
  exact ⟨p,square,out,point,cx,cy,product,same ▸ cs,reference,line,co⟩

/-- Even an unrestricted alias index can produce only canonical line output
on success; no second point-success or field-domain premise is introduced. -/
theorem successful (u : Usize) (out : U32)
    (run : R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node NEA_FieldProduct.ops
      R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations u=ok out) : out.val<2147483647 := by
  unfold R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node at run
  obtain ⟨p,point,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  have cp := NEB_PointSuccess.canonical u p point
  obtain ⟨square,mul,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨d,doubled,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨s,product,_,cs⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod p.x p.x
  have sameSquare : square=s := Result.ok.inj (mul.symm.trans product)
  subst square
  obtain ⟨double,add,_,cd⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod s s cs cs
  have doubleRun : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double s=ok double := by
    simpa only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double] using add
  have sameDouble : d=double := Result.ok.inj (doubled.symm.trans doubleRun)
  subst d
  obtain ⟨z,sub,_,cz⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod double 1#u32 cd (by decide)
  have sameOut : out=z := Result.ok.inj (run.symm.trans sub)
  exact sameOut.symm ▸ cz

#print axioms admitted
#print axioms successful
end NEB_LineCalls

import NEB_PointCalls
import Port3_PushFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEB_PointSuccess
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1QueryGeometryActual
open AspisR1.Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)

theorem read_bound {T : Type} {n : Usize} (a : Array T n) (i : Usize) (x : T)
    (read : Array.index_usize a i=ok x) : i.val<n.val := by
  by_contra bad
  have length : a.val.length=n.val := a.property
  have absent : a.val[i.val]?=none := List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)
  simp [Array.index_usize,absent] at read

/-- Successful output canonicality does not require an independent valid-index
hypothesis: the SAME execution's successful reads establish both table domains. -/
theorem canonical (u : Usize) (point : domain.Point field.M31)
    (run : fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u=ok point) :
    point.x.val<2147483647 ∧ point.y.val<2147483647 := by
  unfold fast_domain.fibre_point at run
  obtain ⟨ix,_,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨iA,_,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨a,readA,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨left,leftRun,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨iB,_,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨b,readB,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨right,rightRun,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  obtain ⟨product,mul,finalRun⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  have ca := NEA_TableCanonical.readA iA (read_bound _ _ _ readA) a readA
  have cb := NEA_TableCanonical.readB iB (read_bound _ _ _ readB) b readB
  have la : fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops a=ok ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ := by cases a; rfl
  have lb : fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops b=ok ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ := by cases b; rfl
  have sameLeft := Result.ok.inj (leftRun.symm.trans la)
  have sameRight := Result.ok.inj (rightRun.symm.trans lb)
  rw [sameLeft,sameRight] at mul
  obtain ⟨z,productRun,cz,_⟩ := NEA_PointComplete.emitted_interpretation.multiply
    ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ ca cb
  have same : product=z := Result.ok.inj (mul.symm.trans productRun)
  subst product
  have samePoint : point=({x:=z.a,y:=z.b} : domain.Point field.M31) :=
    (Result.ok.inj finalRun).symm
  rw [samePoint]
  exact cz

#print axioms read_bound
#print axioms canonical
end NEB_PointSuccess

import NEA_Reference.Funs
import R17CurrentM31Semantics
import ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub
import NDD_ScalarCanon
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEA_LineTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev M := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31

theorem sub_one (d : U32) (canonical : d.val < 2147483647) :
    (if d >= 1#u32 then (UScalar.sub d 1#u32 : Result U32) else UScalar.sub 2147483647#u32 1#u32) =
      AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub d 1#u32 := by
  obtain ⟨out,run,value,_⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod
    d 1#u32 canonical (by decide)
  rw [run]
  split
  · have positive : (1#u32).val ≤ d.val := by scalar_tac
    change 1 ≤ d.val at positive
    obtain ⟨z,raw,zvalue⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.sub_success d 1#u32 positive
    have equal : z=out := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      rw [zvalue,value]
      change d.val-1=(d.val+2147483647-1)%2147483647
      omega
    simpa only [equal] using raw
  · have zero : d=0#u32 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by scalar_tac)
    subst d
    have expected : out.val=2147483646 := by
      rw [value]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨z,raw,zvalue⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.sub_success
      2147483647#u32 1#u32 (by decide)
    have equal : z=out := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by rw [zvalue,expected];rfl)
    simpa only [equal] using raw

theorem reference (s : U32) (canonical : s.val < 2147483647) :
    NEA_Reference.line_double_sub_ref s = (do
      let d ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double s
      AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub d 1#u32) := by
  obtain ⟨d,run,_,cd⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod s s canonical canonical
  have doubled : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double s=ok d := by
    simpa only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double] using run
  calc
    NEA_Reference.line_double_sub_ref s =
        (do let d ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double s
            if d >= 1#u32 then UScalar.sub d 1#u32 else UScalar.sub 2147483647#u32 1#u32) := by
      simp only [NEA_Reference.line_double_sub_ref,
        AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double,
        AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.add,
        AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.P,bind_assoc_eq,NDD_ResultLaws.bind_return,HSub.hSub,Aeneas.Std.instHSubUScalarResult]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [doubled]
      simpa only [bind_tc_ok] using sub_one d cd

#print axioms sub_one
#print axioms reference
end NEA_LineTail

  cases r with

import NEB_GeometryPrimitives
import NEA_Index
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEB_GeometryIndices
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)

def indexPort {CoreError : Type} (error : CoreError) (u : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result Usize CoreError) := do
  let r ← NEA_Reference.fibre_new_ref u
  ok (match r with | .Ok f => .Ok f | .Err _ => .Err error)

def install {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) : Ops CoreError :=
  {NEB_GeometryPrimitives.install ops with op12:=indexPort error}

theorem accepted {CoreError : Type} (error : CoreError) (u f : Usize)
    (run : indexPort error u=ok (.Ok f)) : f=u ∧ f.val<262144 := by
  unfold indexPort at run
  obtain ⟨r,reference,run⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
  cases r with
  | Err e => cases run
  | Ok x =>
    cases Result.ok.inj run
    obtain ⟨same,bound⟩ := NEA_Index.accepted u f reference
    exact ⟨same,by rw [same];exact bound⟩

theorem admitted {CoreError : Type} (error : CoreError) (u : Usize)
    (bound : u.val<262144) : indexPort error u=ok (.Ok u) := by
  simp only [indexPort,NEA_Index.canonical_index u bound,bind_tc_ok]

theorem primitives {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) :
    Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives (install ops error) := by
  have p := NEB_GeometryPrimitives.primitives ops
  exact ⟨p.point,p.line,p.multiply,p.double,p.one,p.subtract⟩

/-- These are precisely the parent, left and right scalar expressions in the
emitted gather body. All index domains follow from its first accepted index. -/
theorem aligned {CoreError : Type} (error : CoreError) (u : Usize) (bound : u.val<262144) :
    ∃ parent left right : Usize,
      u / 4#usize=ok parent ∧
      left=Usize.wrapping_mul parent 4#usize ∧
      right=Usize.wrapping_add left 3#usize ∧
      left.val=u.val/4*4 ∧ right.val=u.val/4*4+3 ∧
      left.val<262144 ∧ right.val<262144 ∧
      indexPort error left=ok (.Ok left) ∧ indexPort error right=ok (.Ok right) := by
  obtain ⟨parent,division,value⟩ := UScalar.div_spec u (y:=4#usize) (by decide)
  have pv : parent.val=u.val/4 := value
  let left := Usize.wrapping_mul parent 4#usize
  let right := Usize.wrapping_add left 3#usize
  have cap : 262144 < UScalar.size .Usize := by rw [UScalar.size_def];scalar_tac
  have lv : left.val=u.val/4*4 := by
    dsimp only [left]
    rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
    change (parent.val*4)%UScalar.size .Usize=u.val/4*4
    rw [pv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have rv : right.val=u.val/4*4+3 := by
    dsimp only [right]
    rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
    change (left.val+3)%UScalar.size .Usize=u.val/4*4+3
    rw [lv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  have lb : left.val<262144 := by rw [lv];omega
  have rb : right.val<262144 := by rw [rv];omega
  exact ⟨parent,left,right,division,rfl,rfl,lv,rv,lb,rb,admitted error left lb,admitted error right rb⟩

#print axioms accepted
#print axioms admitted
#print axioms primitives
#print axioms aligned
end NEB_GeometryIndices
end

import NEB_LineCalls
import Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEB_GeometryPrimitives
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody
open Port3_PushFrame (bind_success)

/-- Install actual emitted field/point operations. Unrelated standard-library
and error ports remain those of the root physical interpretation. -/
def install {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) : Ops CoreError :=
  {ops with
    op15 := fun f => do
      let p ← AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops f
      ok ⟨p.x,p.y⟩
    op14 := R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node NEA_FieldProduct.ops R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations
    op9 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul
    op10 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double
    op8 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub
    op7 := ok 1#u32}

/-- This discharges the inner SessionAPrimitives predicate; it is a theorem,
not a new caller premise or an assumed geometry-success conclusion. -/
theorem primitives {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) :
    Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives (install ops) := by
  refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro f p run
    change (do let q ← AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops f
               ok ({x:=q.x,y:=q.y} : aspis_core.r0.domain.Point U32))=ok p at run
    obtain ⟨q,point,finalRun⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ run
    have cq := NEB_PointSuccess.canonical f q point
    have same : ({x:=q.x,y:=q.y} : aspis_core.r0.domain.Point U32)=p := Result.ok.inj finalRun
    rw [← same]
    exact cq
  · intro f x run
    exact NEB_LineCalls.successful f x run
  · intro x y z cx cy run
    obtain ⟨w,product,_,cw⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod x y
    have same : w=z := Result.ok.inj (product.symm.trans run)
    exact same ▸ cw
  · intro x y cx run
    obtain ⟨w,add,_,cw⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod x x cx cx
    have doubled : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double x=ok w := by simpa only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double] using add
    have same : w=y := Result.ok.inj (doubled.symm.trans run)
    exact same ▸ cw
  · intro x run
    change ok 1#u32=ok x at run
    cases run
    change (1#u32).val<2147483647
    decide
  · intro x y z cx cy run
    obtain ⟨w,sub,_,cw⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod x y cx cy
    have same : w=z := Result.ok.inj (sub.symm.trans run)
    exact same ▸ cw

#print axioms primitives
end NEB_GeometryPrimitives
end

import NEA_Reference.Funs
import NDH_Geometry
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEA_Index
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def PacketDomain (_ : Usize) : Prop := True

theorem all_inputs (x : Usize) :
    NEA_Reference.fibre_new_ref x = ok
      (if x < 262144#usize then core.result.Result.Ok x else core.result.Result.Err 1#u8) := by
  simp only [NEA_Reference.fibre_new_ref]
  split <;> rfl

theorem accepted (x y : Usize)
    (run : NEA_Reference.fibre_new_ref x = ok (core.result.Result.Ok y)) :
    y = x ∧ x.val < 262144 := by
  rw [all_inputs] at run
  split at run
  · cases run
    exact ⟨rfl, by scalar_tac⟩
  · cases run

/-- The constructor's accepted value is the exact index consumed by the actual
emitted geometry call, whose FibreIndex carrier is Usize. No helper stand-in. -/
theorem fibre_caller (ops : AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.CM31Ops) (x y : Usize)
    (run : NEA_Reference.fibre_new_ref x = ok (core.result.Result.Ok y)) :
    AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point ops y =
      AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point ops x := by
  rw [(accepted x y run).1]

theorem aligned_domain (u : Nat) (bound : u < 262144) :
    u / 4 * 4 < 262144 ∧ u / 4 * 4 + 3 < 262144 := by omega

theorem canonical_index (x : Usize) (bound : x.val < 262144) :
    NEA_Reference.fibre_new_ref x = ok (core.result.Result.Ok x) := by
  rw [all_inputs]
  have h : x < 262144#usize := by scalar_tac
  rw [if_pos h]

#print axioms all_inputs
#print axioms accepted
#print axioms fibre_caller
#print axioms aligned_domain
#print axioms canonical_index
end NEA_Index

import NEW_GeometryContext
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEW_GeometryComplete
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open NEW_GeometryRawInterface NEW_GeometryDictionary
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

theorem step (start : Usize) (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (lines flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32) :
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body ops start iter lines flat =
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted start iter lines flat := by
  rw [dictionary]
  exact NEW_GeometryContext.step start iter lines flat

theorem complete_loop (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (start : Usize) (lines flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32) :
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 ops iter start lines flat =
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0 adopted iter start lines flat := by
  simp only [Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0,step]

theorem adopted_root (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize) :
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range ops queries start finish =
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range adopted queries start finish := by
  simp only [Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range,complete_loop]

/-- Universal full Result correspondence with the adopted cohort root.
There is no parent-success, child-output, domain or inner-bridge premise. -/
theorem complete_raw (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize) :
    resultMap answer (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish) =
    Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range adopted queries start finish := by
  exact (NEW_GeometryRawRoot.complete queries start finish).trans (adopted_root queries start finish)

/-- Apply the existing lossless error-name transport to the headline cohort interface. -/
theorem complete (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize) :
    Port3_QueryInstall.result
      (resultMap answer (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)) =
    Port3_GeometryStage.geometry adopted queries start finish := by
  unfold Port3_GeometryStage.geometry
  rw [complete_raw]

/-- Persistent state is unchanged; the complete successful geometry and every
rejection/failure/divergence are retained in the result component. Physical
allocation/copy observations are a separate native packet. -/
theorem result_state {State : Type} (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start finish : Usize) (state : State) :
    (Port3_QueryInstall.result (resultMap answer (NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range queries start finish)),state) =
    (Port3_GeometryStage.geometry adopted queries start finish,state) := by
  rw [complete]

order, canonical nonzero operands, SAME-vector reciprocal cells and all five
collected lanes. Acceptance is the root result being characterized. -/

    ∃ flat inverse : alloc.vec.Vec U32,
      out.start=start ∧ out.line_z.val.length=finish.val-start.val ∧
      flat.val.length=5*(finish.val-start.val) ∧

        S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell inverse.val j)=

      out.inverses.val=(List.range (finish.val-start.val)).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse) := by
  rw [complete] at run
  exact NEB_ActualGeometryModel.for_range ops err queries start finish out nonempty run

import NEW_GeometryPrefix

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEW_GeometryRawInterface
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1
namespace N
abbrev G := NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry
abbrev E := NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.Error
end N
namespace O
abbrev G := AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry
abbrev E := AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Error
end O

def geometry (g : N.G) : O.G := ⟨g.start,g.inverses,g.line_z⟩
def geometryBack (g : O.G) : N.G := ⟨g.start,g.inverses,g.line_z⟩
def error : N.E → O.E
 | .Parse => .Parse | .Semantic => .Semantic | .Transcript => .Transcript
 | .Relation => .Relation | .Merkle => .Merkle | .Query => .Query
 | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint | .Allocation => .Allocation

def errorBack : O.E → N.E
 | .Parse => .Parse | .Semantic => .Semantic | .Transcript => .Transcript
 | .Relation => .Relation | .Merkle => .Merkle | .Query => .Query
 | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint | .Allocation => .Allocation

def answer : core.result.Result N.G N.E → core.result.Result O.G O.E
 | .Ok g => .Ok (geometry g)
 | .Err e => .Err (error e)

def answerBack : core.result.Result O.G O.E → core.result.Result N.G N.E
 | .Ok g => .Ok (geometryBack g)
 | .Err e => .Err (errorBack e)

theorem geometry_roundtrip (g : N.G) : geometryBack (geometry g)=g := by cases g; rfl
theorem geometry_reverse (g : O.G) : geometry (geometryBack g)=g := by cases g; rfl
theorem error_roundtrip (e : N.E) : errorBack (error e)=e := by cases e <;> rfl
theorem error_reverse (e : O.E) : error (errorBack e)=e := by cases e <;> rfl
theorem answer_roundtrip (r : core.result.Result N.G N.E) : answerBack (answer r)=r := by
 cases r with
 | Ok g => cases g; rfl
 | Err e => cases e <;> rfl

theorem answer_reverse (r : core.result.Result O.G O.E) : answer (answerBack r)=r := by
 cases r with
 | Ok g => cases g; rfl
 | Err e => cases e <;> rfl

/-- Complete dictionary read directly from the actual extracted caller.
No result equality, parent acceptance or freely chosen child operation. -/
def ops : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.Ops NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.r0.Error where
 op0 := core.array.from_fn
 op1 := core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.map.default
 op2 := core.result.Result.map_err
 op3 := core.slice.iter.Iter.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIteratorSharedAT.any
 op4 := alloc.vec.Vec.is_empty
 op5 := NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.eq
 op6 := ok NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO
 op7 := ok NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.ONE
 op8 := NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.sub
 op9 := NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.mul
 op10 := NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.double
 op11 := NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.inv
 op12 := NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.r0.domain.FibreIndex.new
 op13 := NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.batch_prefix_products
 op14 := NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.line_node
 op15 := fun u => do
   let p ← NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point u
   ok ⟨p.x,p.y⟩
 mapIterator := fun it f => {next := core.iter.adapters.map.Map.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next it f}

import NEB_GeometryDictionaryEq
import NEB_GeometryModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEB_ActualGeometryModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody

/-- The actual R17 point/line dictionary, with the checked index reference and
inverse body already selected in the adopted geometry model. This is a model
installation, not a substitute for the missing frozen native root bridge. -/
def install {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) : Ops CoreError :=
  {NEB_GeometryModel.install ops error with
    op15 := fun f => do
      let p ← AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations f
      ok ⟨p.x,p.y⟩
    op14 := R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations}

theorem same_dictionary {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) :
    install ops error = NEB_GeometryModel.install ops error := by
  have hp : (fun f => do
      let p ← AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations f
      ok ({x:=p.x,y:=p.y} : aspis_core.r0.domain.Point U32)) =
    (fun f => do
      let p ← AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops f
      ok ({x:=p.x,y:=p.y} : aspis_core.r0.domain.Point U32)) := by
    funext f
    rw [NEB_GeometryDictionaryEq.point]
  have hl := funext NEB_GeometryDictionaryEq.line
  unfold install
  rw [hp,hl]
  rfl

theorem primitives {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) :
    Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives (install ops error) := by
  rw [same_dictionary]
  exact NEB_GeometryModel.primitives ops error

/-- Every non-root canonical primitive premise is discharged for the actual
R17 dictionary. The sole success premise is the same parent model Result. -/
theorem for_range {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError)
    (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize) (out : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (nonempty : start.val<end1.val)
    (accepted : Port3_GeometryStage.geometry
      (Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.install (install ops error)) queries start end1=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ flat inverse : alloc.vec.Vec U32,
      out.start=start ∧ out.line_z.val.length=end1.val-start.val ∧
      flat.val.length=5*(end1.val-start.val) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flat.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flat.val, S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x≠0) ∧
      inverse.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
      (∀ j, j<flat.val.length →
        S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell inverse.val j)=
          (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell flat.val j))⁻¹) ∧
      out.inverses.val=(List.range (end1.val-start.val)).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse) := by
  rw [same_dictionary] at accepted
  exact NEB_GeometryModel.for_range ops error queries start end1 out nonempty accepted

import NEB_ActualGeometryPoint
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEB_GeometryDictionaryEq

theorem point (u : Usize) :
    fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations u=
      fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u := by
  unfold fast_domain.fibre_point
  simp only [domain.FibreIndex.get,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  generalize readA : Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_A (u &&& 511#usize)=ra
  cases ra with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok a =>
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [show fast_domain.table_value R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations a=ok ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ from by cases a;rfl,
        show fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops a=ok ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ from by cases a;rfl]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    generalize shift : u >>> 9#i32=shifted
    cases shifted with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok iB =>
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      generalize readB : Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_B iB=rb
      cases rb with
      | fail e => rfl
      | div => rfl
      | ok b =>
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        rw [show fast_domain.table_value R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations b=ok ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ from by cases b;rfl,
            show fast_domain.table_value NEA_FieldProduct.ops b=ok ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ from by cases b;rfl]
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        have ca := NEA_TableCanonical.readA (u &&& 511#usize)
          (NEB_PointSuccess.read_bound _ _ _ readA) a readA
        have cb := NEA_TableCanonical.readB iB (NEB_PointSuccess.read_bound _ _ _ readB) b readB
        rw [NEB_GeometryFieldPorts.cm_eq ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ ca cb]

theorem line (u : Usize) :
    R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations u=
      R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node NEA_FieldProduct.ops R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations u := by
  unfold R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node
  rw [point]

theorem point_success (u : Usize) (p : domain.Point field.M31)
    (run : fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations u=ok p) :
    p.x.val<2147483647 ∧ p.y.val<2147483647 := by
  rw [point] at run
  exact NEB_PointSuccess.canonical u p run

    (run : R17FibrePointLineNodeActual.line_node R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations
      R17CurrentM31Semantics.operations u=ok out) : out.val<2147483647 := by
  rw [line] at run
  exact NEB_LineCalls.successful u out run

import NEB_GeometryFieldPorts

namespace NEB_ActualGeometryPoint
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 AspisR1QueryGeometryActual

/-- The actual selected table reads establish both product domains; the
original deployed-cohort dictionary is used in the returned point equation. -/
theorem calls (u : Usize) (admitted : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ (iA iB : Usize) (a b : U32 × U32) (z : field.CM31),
      lift (u &&& 511#usize)=ok iA ∧ u >>> 9#i32=ok iB ∧
      Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_A iA=ok a ∧
      Array.index_usize fast_domain.TABLE_B iB=ok b ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ∧ NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical ⟨b.1,b.2⟩ ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.ops.mul ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩=ok z ∧
      R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations.mul ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩=ok z ∧
      NEA_FieldProduct.Canonical z ∧
      NEA_PointParam.point_ref u fast_domain.TABLE_A fast_domain.TABLE_B
        (Array.make 2#usize [z.a,z.b])=ok (NEA_PointBridge.record a b z) ∧
      fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations u=ok ⟨z.a,z.b⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨iA,iB,a,b,z,mask,shift,readA,readB,ca,cb,mul,cz,_⟩ :=
    NEB_PointCalls.selected_product u admitted
  have actual : R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations.mul ⟨a.1,a.2⟩ ⟨b.1,b.2⟩=ok z :=
    (NEB_GeometryFieldPorts.cm_eq _ _ ca cb).trans mul
  have selected := NEA_PointBridge.selected R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations u iA iB a b z
    mask shift readA readB (fun _ _ => rfl) actual
  exact ⟨iA,iB,a,b,z,mask,shift,readA,readB,ca,cb,mul,actual,cz,selected.1,selected.2⟩

theorem frame {S Event : Type} (state : S) (u : Usize) (admitted : NEA_PointBridge.PacketDomain u) :
    ∃ point : domain.Point field.M31,
      fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations u=ok point ∧
      point.x.val<2147483647 ∧ point.y.val<2147483647 ∧
      NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state
        (fast_domain.fibre_point R17CurrentCM31Semantics.operations u)=ok (point,state,[]) := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,z,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,cz,_,run⟩ := calls u admitted
  exact ⟨⟨z.a,z.b⟩,run,cz.1,cz.2,NEB_PureFrame.successful state _ _ run⟩

#print axioms calls
#print axioms frame
end NEB_ActualGeometryPoint

def install {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) : Ops CoreError :=
  {NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error with op11:=Port4C_InverseExecution.inverse_owned}

theorem primitives {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) :
    Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives (install ops error) := by
  have p := NEB_GeometryIndices.primitives ops error
  exact ⟨p.point,p.line,p.multiply,p.double,p.one,p.subtract⟩

/-- All inner canonical primitive predicates and the chosen inverse operation
are instantiated. The premise is the SAME adopted model parent success, not
an additional prefix/inverse/collect success premise or a native claim. -/
theorem for_range {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError)
    (queries : Array U32 22#usize) (start end1 : Usize) (out : verifier.QueryGeometry)
    (nonempty : start.val<end1.val)
    (accepted : Port3_GeometryStage.geometry
      (Port5Q1_GeometryTerminal.install (install ops error)) queries start end1=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ flat inverse : alloc.vec.Vec U32,
      out.start=start ∧ out.line_z.val.length=end1.val-start.val ∧
      flat.val.length=5*(end1.val-start.val) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flat.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flat.val, S7JoinBasisMachine.decode x≠0) ∧
      inverse.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
      (∀ j, j<flat.val.length →
        S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell inverse.val j)=
          (S7JoinBasisMachine.decode (Port4C_BatchInverse.cell flat.val j))⁻¹) ∧
      out.inverses.val=(List.range (end1.val-start.val)).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse) :=
  Port5Q1_Geometry.for_range (install ops error) (primitives ops error) rfl rfl rfl
    queries start end1 out nonempty accepted

import NEB_GeometryIndices
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEB_GeometryGatherDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1 AspisR1Stage2
open Port3_NativeGeometryBody

theorem step {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError) (start : Usize)
    (iter iter1 iterOut : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (query : U32)
    (zs zsOut flat flatOut : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (next : core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next iter=ok (some query,iter1))
    (run : verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
      (Port4C_GeometryStd.install (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error))
      start iter zs flat=ok (cont (iterOut,zsOut,flatOut))) :
    ∃ (r : Port4C_GeometryGather.Row) (u parent left right fibre fleft fright : Usize)
      (point : aspis_core.r0.domain.Point U32) (square doubled one : U32),
      iterOut=iter1 ∧
      lift (UScalar.cast .Usize query)=ok u ∧
      NEB_GeometryIndices.indexPort error u=ok (.Ok fibre) ∧ fibre=u ∧ fibre.val<262144 ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op15 fibre=ok point ∧
      point.x.val<2147483647 ∧ point.y.val<2147483647 ∧
      u/4#usize=ok parent ∧ left=Usize.wrapping_mul parent 4#usize ∧
      NEB_GeometryIndices.indexPort error left=ok (.Ok fleft) ∧ fleft=left ∧ fleft.val<262144 ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op14 fleft=ok r.lineX ∧ r.lineX.val<2147483647 ∧
      right=Usize.wrapping_add left 3#usize ∧
      NEB_GeometryIndices.indexPort error right=ok (.Ok fright) ∧ fright=right ∧ fright.val<262144 ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op14 fright=ok r.lineY ∧ r.lineY.val<2147483647 ∧
      r.x=point.x ∧ r.y=point.y ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op9 r.lineX r.lineX=ok square ∧ square.val<2147483647 ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op10 square=ok doubled ∧ doubled.val<2147483647 ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op7=ok one ∧ one.val<2147483647 ∧
      (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error).op8 doubled one=ok r.lineZ ∧ r.lineZ.val<2147483647 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ r.words, x≠0#u32) ∧
      flatOut.val=flat.val++r.words ∧ zsOut.val=zs.val++[r.lineZ] := by
  obtain ⟨r,u,parent,left,right,fibre,fleft,fright,point,square,doubled,one,fields⟩ :=
    Port4C_GeometryGather.step (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error) start
      iter iter1 iterOut query zs zsOut flat flatOut next run
  rcases fields with ⟨it,cast,new,pointRun,division,leftEq,newLeft,lineX,rightEq,newRight,lineY,hx,hy,mul,dbl,unit,sub,raw,append,zsEq⟩
  have fi := NEB_GeometryIndices.accepted error u fibre new
  have fl := NEB_GeometryIndices.accepted error left fleft newLeft
  have fr := NEB_GeometryIndices.accepted error right fright newRight
  have leaves := NEB_GeometryIndices.primitives ops error
  have cp := leaves.point _ _ pointRun
  have cx := leaves.line _ _ lineX
  have cy := leaves.line _ _ lineY
  have cs := leaves.multiply _ _ _ cx cx mul
  have cd := leaves.double _ _ cs dbl
  have co := leaves.one _ unit
  have cz := leaves.subtract _ _ _ cd co sub
  exact ⟨r,u,parent,left,right,fibre,fleft,fright,point,square,doubled,one,
    it,cast,new,fi.1,fi.2,pointRun,cp.1,cp.2,division,leftEq,newLeft,fl.1,fl.2,lineX,cx,
    rightEq,newRight,fr.1,fr.2,lineY,cy,hx,hy,mul,cs,dbl,cd,unit,co,sub,cz,raw,append,zsEq⟩

theorem traversal {CoreError : Type} (ops : Ops CoreError) (error : CoreError)
    (start : Usize) (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (zs flat : alloc.vec.Vec U32)
    (out : verifier.QueryGeometry) (fuel : Nat)
    (remaining : iter.i+fuel=iter.slice.val.length)
    (canonical : ∀ x ∈ flat.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x)
    (raw : ∀ x ∈ flat.val, x≠0#u32)
    (run : verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0
      (Port4C_GeometryStd.install (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error))
      iter start zs flat=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ zsFinal flatFinal terminal,
      (∀ x ∈ flatFinal.val, Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.Canonical x) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ flatFinal.val, x≠0#u32) ∧
      verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body
        (Port4C_GeometryStd.install (NEB_GeometryIndices.install ops error))
        start terminal zsFinal flatFinal=ok (done (.Ok out)) ∧
      terminal.i=terminal.slice.val.length ∧
      zsFinal.val.length=zs.val.length+fuel ∧ flatFinal.val.length=flat.val.length+5*fuel :=
  Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.traversal _ (NEB_GeometryIndices.primitives ops error)
    start iter zs flat out fuel remaining canonical raw run

#print axioms step
#print axioms traversal
end NEB_GeometryGatherDomains
end

NEW_LoopMap.source:
import Aeneas
import JFv_RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEW_LoopMap
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

def flowMap {S A B : Type} (f : A → B) : ControlFlow S A → ControlFlow S B
 | .cont s => .cont s
 | .done a => .done (f a)

def bodyMap {S A B : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S A)) (f : A → B)
    (s : S) : Result (ControlFlow S B) := resultMap (flowMap f) (body s)

theorem map_ok {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (a : A) : resultMap f (ok a)=ok (f a) := rfl
theorem map_fail {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (e : Error) : resultMap f (fail e)=fail e := rfl
theorem map_div {A B : Type} (f : A → B) : resultMap f div=div := rfl

/-- A defined native loop result follows the mapped loop with the SAME
continuation state. Failure is retained; no termination or output premise. -/
theorem defined_result {S A B : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S A)) (f : A → B)
    (s : S) : loop body s=div ∨ resultMap f (loop body s)=loop (bodyMap body f) s := by
  have all : ∀ s, loop body s=div ∨ resultMap f (loop body s)=loop (bodyMap body f) s := by
    apply loop.fixpoint_induct body (fun rec =>
      ∀ s, rec s=div ∨ resultMap f (rec s)=loop (bodyMap body f) s)
    · refine Lean.Order.admissible_pi_apply
        (fun x (r : Result A) => r=div ∨ resultMap f r=loop (bodyMap body f) x) ?_
      intro x
      apply Lean.Order.admissible_flatOrder
      exact Or.inl rfl
    · intro rec ih x
      rw [loop.eq_def]
      cases hb : body x with
      | div => simp only [bodyMap,hb,map_div] <;> exact Or.inl True.intro
      | fail e => simp only [bodyMap,hb,map_fail] <;> exact Or.inr True.intro
      | ok c =>
        cases c with
        | done a => simp only [bodyMap,hb,map_ok,flowMap] <;> exact Or.inr True.intro
        | cont next => simpa only [bodyMap,hb,map_ok,flowMap] using ih next
  exact all s

theorem body_inverse {S A B : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S A))
    (f : A → B) (g : B → A) (back : ∀ a, g (f a)=a) :
    bodyMap (bodyMap body f) g = body := by
  funext s
  cases h : body s with
  | div => simp only [bodyMap,h,map_div]
  | fail e => simp only [bodyMap,h,map_fail]
  | ok c => cases c <;> simp only [bodyMap,h,map_ok,flowMap,back]

theorem map_inverse {A B : Type} (f : A → B) (g : B → A)
    (back : ∀ b, f (g b)=b) (r : Result B) : resultMap f (resultMap g r)=r := by
  cases r <;> simp only [map_ok,map_fail,map_div,back]

/-- Full partial Result transport through a lossless nominal return map.
Both loop state and cont transitions are identical. Divergence and every
failure are preserved using fixpoint induction in BOTH directions. -/
theorem complete {S A B : Type} (body : S → Result (ControlFlow S A))
    (f : A → B) (g : B → A) (gf : ∀ a, g (f a)=a) (fg : ∀ b, f (g b)=b)
    (s : S) : resultMap f (loop body s)=loop (bodyMap body f) s := by
  have forward := defined_result body f s
  have backward := defined_result (bodyMap body f) g s
  rw [body_inverse body f g gf] at backward
  rcases forward with nativeDiv | done
  · rcases backward with modelDiv | done
    · rw [nativeDiv,modelDiv]; rfl
    · have same := congrArg (resultMap f) done
      simpa only [map_inverse f g fg] using same.symm
  · exact done

#print axioms map_ok
#print axioms map_fail
#print axioms map_div
#print axioms defined_result
#print axioms body_inverse
#print axioms map_inverse
#print axioms complete
end NEW_LoopMap

import NEW_LoopMap

open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20

theorem pair {A B C D : Type} (f : C → D) (p : A × B) (k : A → B → Result C) :
    resultMap f (let (a,b) := p; k a b) =
      (let (a,b) := p; resultMap f (k a b)) := by cases p; rfl

    (someCase : A → Result B) :
    resultMap f (match o with | none => noneCase | some a => someCase a) =
      (match o with | none => resultMap f noneCase | some a => resultMap f (someCase a)) := by
  cases o <;> rfl

import NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEW_GeometryPoint
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1
open AspisR1PublicPreparation.RawExtractedSemanticCallOpsV20
open NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives

theorem map_point_ok (x y : U32) :
    resultMap toP (ok ({x,y} : P)) = ok ({x,y} : GP) := rfl

/-- Entire point Result for every alias index. Both actual table reads and
both failure/divergence branches are preserved. No child-success premise. -/
theorem complete (u : Usize) :
    resultMap toP (NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point u) =
      AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point NEA_FieldProduct.ops u := by
  simp only [NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point,
    AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.fibre_point,
    NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.r0.domain.FibreIndex.get,
    AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.domain.FibreIndex.get,
    resultMap_bind,map_point_ok,lift,bind_tc_ok,tableA,tableB,
    NEW_ShiftAssociation.checked_to_wrapping]
  generalize ha : Array.index_usize AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.TABLE_A
    (u &&& 511#usize) = a
  cases a with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok a =>
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    generalize hb : Array.index_usize AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.TABLE_B
      (Usize.wrapping_shr u 9#u32) = b
    cases b with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok b =>
      rcases a with ⟨a0,a1⟩
      rcases b with ⟨b0,b1⟩
      simp only [NEW_GeometryActual.fast_domain.table_value,
        NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.CM31.new,
        AspisR1QueryGeometryActual.fast_domain.table_value,NEA_FieldProduct.ops,
        NEA_FieldProduct.toNative,NEA_FieldProduct.ofNative,bind_tc_ok,map_point_ok]
      try dsimp only
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,bind_assoc_eq]
      change (do let c ← NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
                    ({a:=a0,b:=a1} : NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives.C)
                    ({a:=b0,b:=b1} : NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives.C)
                 ok ({x:=c.a,y:=c.b} : GP)) =
        (do let c ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul ⟨a0,a1⟩ ⟨b0,b1⟩
            ok ({x:=c.a,y:=c.b} : GP))
      have product := NEW_GeometryArithmetic.cm_multiply
        ({a:=a0,b:=a1} : NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives.C)
        ({a:=b0,b:=b1} : NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives.C)
      simp only [NEW_GeometryArithmetic.toC] at product
      rw [←product]
      cases NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
        ({a:=a0,b:=a1} : NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives.C)
        ({a:=b0,b:=b1} : NEW_GeometryPointPrimitives.C) <;> rfl

#print axioms map_point_ok
#print axioms complete
end NEW_GeometryPoint

NEW_LiteralRefl.source:
import Lean
/-! Direct proof construction for aliases of identical frozen literal tables.
The kernel checks the resulting Eq.refl against the ORIGINAL equality target.
No oracle, new axiom, conversion admission or recursion-limit change is used.
This avoids recursive simplifier traversal of a 512-cell literal expression. -/
open Lean Meta Elab Tactic in
elab "NEW_literal_refl" : tactic => do
 let goal ← getMainGoal
 let target ← goal.getType
 let some (_,lhs,_) := target.eq? | throwError "expected an equality"
 goal.assign (← mkEqRefl lhs)
 replaceMainGoal []

namespace NEW_ShiftAssociation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem checked_to_wrapping (u : Usize) :
    (u >>> 9#i32 : Result Usize) = ok (Usize.wrapping_shr u 9#u32) := by
  have hbits : 9 < System.Platform.numBits := by
    have lower := System.Platform.sixteen_le_numBits
    omega
  obtain ⟨z,hz,_,bits⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.ShiftRight_IScalar_spec u 9#i32 (by decide) (by change (9 : Int) < (System.Platform.numBits : Int); omega))
  rw [hz]
  congr 1
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  change z.bv.toNat = (Usize.wrapping_shr u 9#u32).bv.toNat
  apply congrArg BitVec.toNat
  rw [bits,Usize.wrapping_shr_bv_eq]
  change (u.bv >>> 9) = (u.bv >>> (9 % System.Platform.numBits))
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbits]

#print axioms checked_to_wrapping
end NEW_ShiftAssociation

import NFB_ZeroFinite
import NDI_IteratorFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_QueryIterator
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Native ptr/end denotes this exact suffix of the original protected input,
not another allocation with equal contents. The kernel part is a value view. -/
def view (queries : List U32) (start count cursor : Nat) : List U32 :=
 ((queries.drop start).take count).drop cursor

theorem view_length (queries : List U32) (start count cursor : Nat)
    (fits : start+count≤queries.length) :
    (view queries start count cursor).length=count-cursor := by
 simp only [view,List.length_drop,NDI_IteratorFrame.remainder queries start count fits]

theorem selected (queries : List U32) (start count cursor : Nat)
    (active : cursor<count) :
    ((queries.drop start).take count)[cursor]?=queries[start+cursor]? :=
 NDI_IteratorFrame.selected queries start count cursor active

theorem advance (queries : List U32) (start count cursor : Nat) :
    (view queries start count cursor).drop 1=view queries start count (cursor+1) := by
 simp only [view,List.drop_drop]

/-- The outer iterator uses the SAME coherent next primitive as the zero
scanner, with no arithmetic or child-domain premise. -/
theorem next (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (active : it.i < it.slice.val.length) :
 core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=
  ok (some it.slice.val[it.i],{it with i:=it.i+1}) := NFB_ZeroFinite.next_active it active

theorem end_next (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (finished : it.slice.val.length ≤ it.i) :
 core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=ok (none,it) := NFB_ZeroFinite.next_end it finished

#print axioms view_length
#print axioms selected
#print axioms advance
#print axioms next
#print axioms end_next
end NFB_QueryIterator

import NFB_ZeroScan
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_ZeroFinite
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow

/-- Finite model retains the SAME slice and its exact native cursor; zero
short-circuit consumes the selected word and retains the untouched suffix. -/
def bounded : Nat → core.slice.iter.Iter U32 → Result (Bool × core.slice.iter.Iter U32)
 | 0,it => ok (false,it)
 | n+1,it => do
   let (next,after) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it
   match next with
   | none => ok (false,after)
   | some value => if decide (value=0#u32) then ok (true,after) else bounded n after

theorem next_active (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (h : it.i < it.slice.val.length) :
    core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it =
      ok (some it.slice.val[it.i],{it with i:=it.i+1}) := by
 unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next
 split
 · rfl
 · rename_i hn; exact False.elim (hn h)

theorem next_end (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (h : it.slice.val.length ≤ it.i) :
    core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it=ok (none,it) := by
 unfold core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next
 split
 · rename_i hn
   have bad : it.i < it.slice.val.length := hn
   omega
 · rfl

/-- Induction is on remaining words, never on an unfolded concrete buffer. -/
theorem complete (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (fuel : Nat)
    (remaining : it.i+fuel=it.slice.val.length) :
    loop NFB_ZeroScan.zeroStep (it,())=bounded fuel it := by
 induction fuel generalizing it with
 | zero =>
   rw [loop.eq_def]
   simp only [NFB_ZeroScan.zeroStep,next_end it (by omega),bind_tc_ok,bounded,uncurry]
 | succ fuel ih =>
   have active : it.i < it.slice.val.length := by omega
   have rest : ({it with i:=it.i+1} : core.slice.iter.Iter U32).i+fuel=it.slice.val.length := by
     simp only; omega
   rw [loop.eq_def]
   simp only [NFB_ZeroScan.zeroStep,next_active it active,bind_tc_ok,bounded,uncurry]
   by_cases hz : decide (it.slice.val[it.i] = 0#u32) = true
   · simp only [hz,if_true]
   · simpa only [hz,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false] using ih {it with i:=it.i+1} rest

#print axioms next_active
#print axioms next_end
#print axioms complete
end NFB_ZeroFinite

import NEW_GeometryComplete
import NEW_InverseComplete
import NEW_GeometryReverse
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_ZeroScan
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1

def zeroStep (state : core.slice.iter.Iter U32 × Unit) :
    Result (ControlFlow (core.slice.iter.Iter U32 × Unit) (Bool × core.slice.iter.Iter U32)) := do
  let (next,it) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next state.1
  match next with
  | none => ok (done (false,it))
  | some value =>
    if decide (value=0#u32) then ok (done (true,it)) else ok (cont (it,()))

/-- The actual emitted zero callback has no arithmetic/domain/effect premise. -/
theorem zero_callback (x : U32) :
    NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedM31Bool.call_mut () x =
      ok (decide (x=0#u32),()) := by
  simp only [NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedM31Bool.call_mut,
    NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.eq,
    NEW_GeometryActual.aspis_core.field.M31.ZERO,bind_tc_ok]

/-- One native iterator/callback observation is associated with this exact
cohort loop body. The primitive is the SAME slice iterator, not a free reply. -/
theorem zero_body (state : core.slice.iter.Iter U32 × Unit) :
    Port3_BatchStd.anyBody (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32)
      NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedM31Bool
      state = zeroStep state := by
  rcases state with ⟨it,u⟩
  cases u
  simp only [Port3_BatchStd.anyBody,zeroStep,
    core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter,
    NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedM31Bool,
    zero_callback,bind_tc_ok,uncurry]
  apply NEW_GeometryRawBody.bind_congr
  rintro ⟨next,after⟩
  cases next with
  | none => rfl
  | some value =>
    simp only [uncurry]

/-- Whole partial Result transport reuses the identical body in the coherent
least-fixpoint loop. This does not unfold a buffer or assume termination. -/
theorem zero_loop (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) :
    Port3_BatchStd.anyDefault (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32)
      NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedM31Bool it () =
      loop zeroStep (it,()) := by
  unfold Port3_BatchStd.anyDefault
  have same := funext zero_body
  rw [same]

theorem native_cursor_cover (n k : Nat) (size : n=10 ∨ n=12) (active : k<n) :
    k=0 ∨ k=1 ∨ k=2 ∨ k=3 ∨ k=4 ∨ k=5 ∨ k=6 ∨ k=7 ∨ k=8 ∨ k=9 ∨ k=10 ∨ k=11 := by omega

theorem native_half_cover (n k : Nat) : k<n/2 ∨ n/2≤k := by omega

theorem zero_witness_cover (row : Fin 5 → U32) :
    (∀ j, row j≠0#u32) ∨ ∃ j, row j=0#u32 := by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∀ j, row j≠0#u32
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (Classical.byContradiction (fun hn => h (fun j hz => hn ⟨j,hz⟩)))

/-- Pure iterator/callback execution carries the separate caller state intact.
Native frame observations and the pinned source establish the same separation. -/
theorem zero_loop_frame {State : Type} (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U32) (state : State) :
    (Port3_BatchStd.anyDefault (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter U32)
      NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedM31Bool it (),state) =
    (loop zeroStep (it,()),state) := by rw [zero_loop]

#print axioms zeroStep
#print axioms zero_callback
#print axioms zero_body
#print axioms zero_loop
#print axioms zero_loop_frame
#print axioms native_cursor_cover
#print axioms native_half_cover
#print axioms zero_witness_cover
#print axioms NEW_GeometryComplete.complete_raw
#print axioms NEW_GeometryComplete.complete
#print axioms NEW_GeometryComplete.result_state
#print axioms NEW_GeometryComplete.accepted
#print axioms NEW_InverseComplete.result_state_effects
#print axioms NEW_GeometryReverse.state
end NFB_ZeroScan

/-- Actual-body extraction identifies the full independent reference, including rejection. -/
theorem reference (x : U32) : NEW_InverseActual.aspis_core.field.M31.inv x =
    NEO_TailRef.inverse NEO_TailReference.inverseOps x :=
  (NEW_InverseAssociation.emitted x).trans (NEO_TailReference.inverse x).symm

/-- Entire Result/state/semantic-effects lift on the same model state.
The runtime's panic interpretation is retained; no empty native panic-I/O claim. -/
theorem result_state_effects {S Event : Type} (state : S) (x : U32) :
    NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state (NEW_InverseActual.aspis_core.field.M31.inv x) =
      NEB_PureFrame.run (Event:=Event) state (Port4C_InverseExecution.inverse_owned x) := by
  rw [NEW_InverseAssociation.cohort]

/-- Reuse the already proved legal DAG. The returned word is now tied to the
ACTUAL frozen extraction, rather than only to the earlier logged clone. -/
theorem nonzero_calls (x : U32) (nonzero : x != 0#u32) :
 ∃ m t2 m1 t4 m2 t8 m3 t16 m4 t24 m5 t28 m6 t29 t30 m7 out : U32,
 let calls := NEO_InverseLog.chain x m t2 m1 t4 m2 t8 m3 t16 m4 t24 m5 t28 m6 t29 t30 m7 out
 calls.length=17 ∧ (∀ call∈calls,NEO_InverseLog.legal call) ∧
 NEW_InverseActual.aspis_core.field.M31.inv x=ok out ∧ out.val<2147483647 := by
 obtain ⟨m,t2,m1,t4,m2,t8,m3,t16,m4,t24,m5,t28,m6,t29,t30,m7,out,count,legal,run,canonical⟩ :=
   NEO_InverseLog.nonzero x nonzero
 exact ⟨m,t2,m1,t4,m2,t8,m3,t16,m4,t24,m5,t28,m6,t29,t30,m7,out,count,legal,
   (reference x).trans run,canonical⟩

#print axioms reference
#print axioms result_state_effects
#print axioms nonzero_calls
end NEW_InverseComplete

import NEO_TailReference
import NEB_PureFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEO_InverseLog
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1
inductive Call where
 | product (left right reply : U32)
 | square (input : U32) (count : Usize) (reply : U32)

def legal : Call → Prop
 | .product a b r => FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul a b=ok r ∧ r.val<2147483647
 | .square a n r => AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul a n=ok r ∧ r.val<2147483647

def chain (x m t2 m1 t4 m2 t8 m3 t16 m4 t24 m5 t28 m6 t29 t30 m7 out : U32) : List Call :=
 [.product x x m,.product m x t2,.square t2 2#usize m1,.product m1 t2 t4,
  .square t4 4#usize m2,.product m2 t4 t8,.square t8 8#usize m3,.product m3 t8 t16,
  .square t16 8#usize m4,.product m4 t8 t24,.square t24 4#usize m5,.product m5 t4 t28,
  .product t28 t28 m6,.product m6 x t29,.product t29 t29 t30,
  .product t30 t30 m7,.product m7 x out]

theorem nonzero (x : U32) (nonzero : x != 0#u32) :
 ∃ m t2 m1 t4 m2 t8 m3 t16 m4 t24 m5 t28 m6 t29 t30 m7 out : U32,
 let calls := chain x m t2 m1 t4 m2 t8 m3 t16 m4 t24 m5 t28 m6 t29 t30 m7 out
 calls.length=17 ∧ (∀ call∈calls,legal call) ∧
 NEO_TailRef.inverse NEO_TailReference.inverseOps x=ok out ∧ out.val<2147483647 := by
 obtain ⟨m,t2,m1,t4,m2,t8,m3,t16,m4,t24,m5,t28,m6,t29,t30,m7,out,
 hm,cm,ht2,ct2,hm1,cm1,ht4,ct4,hm2,cm2,ht8,ct8,hm3,cm3,ht16,ct16,
 hm4,cm4,ht24,ct24,hm5,cm5,ht28,ct28,hm6,cm6,ht29,ct29,ht30,ct30,hm7,cm7,hout,cout,run⟩ :=
 NEB_InverseCalls.nonzero x nonzero
 refine ⟨m,t2,m1,t4,m2,t8,m3,t16,m4,t24,m5,t28,m6,t29,t30,m7,out,?_,?_,?_,cout⟩
 · rfl
 · intro call member
   simp only [chain,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at member
   rcases member with rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl
   all_goals simp_all [legal]
 · rw [NEO_TailReference.inverse]
   exact run

theorem zero : NEO_TailRef.inverse NEO_TailReference.inverseOps 0#u32=fail .assertionFailure := by
 simp [NEO_TailRef.inverse,massert]

#print axioms nonzero
#print axioms zero
end NEO_InverseLog

callee domain/interpretation hypothesis is added. Zero is handled separately. -/

    ∃ m t2 m1 t4 m2 t8 m3 t16 m4 t24 m5 t28 m6 t29 t30 m7 out : U32,
      FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x x=ok m ∧ m.val<2147483647 ∧

      AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul t2 2#usize=ok m1 ∧ m1.val<2147483647 ∧
      FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul m1 t2=ok t4 ∧ t4.val<2147483647 ∧
      AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul t4 4#usize=ok m2 ∧ m2.val<2147483647 ∧
      FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul m2 t4=ok t8 ∧ t8.val<2147483647 ∧

      FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul m5 t4=ok t28 ∧ t28.val<2147483647 ∧
      FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul t28 t28=ok m6 ∧ m6.val<2147483647 ∧
      FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul m6 x=ok t29 ∧ t29.val<2147483647 ∧
