import NBG_SquareTrace
import NEB_PureFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEB_SquareDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1

theorem preserve {n : Nat} {before after : U32}
    (trace : NBG_SquareTrace.Trace n before after) (canonical : before.val<2147483647) :
    after.val<2147483647 := by
  induction trace with
  | done value => exact canonical
  | @step n before middle after cell tail ih =>
    have cm : middle.val<2147483647 := by rw [cell];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    exact ih cm

theorem positive {n : Nat} {before after : U32}
    (trace : NBG_SquareTrace.Trace n before after) (nonempty : 0<n) :
    after.val<2147483647 := by
  cases trace with
  | done value => omega
  | step cell tail =>
    apply preserve tail
    rw [cell]
    exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

theorem trace_exists (n : Nat) (before : U32) :
    ∃ after, NBG_SquareTrace.Trace n before after := by
  induction n generalizing before with
  | zero => exact ⟨before,.done before⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    obtain ⟨middle,run,value,_⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source before before
    obtain ⟨after,tail⟩ := ih middle
    exact ⟨after,.step value tail⟩

/-- All raw initial words are allowed. Canonicality is derived after a positive
number of iterations, never imposed on the zero-iteration return. -/
theorem source (before : U32) (count : Usize) :
    ∃ after, AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul before count=ok after ∧
      NBG_SquareTrace.Trace count.val before after ∧
      (0<count.val → after.val<2147483647) := by
  obtain ⟨after,trace⟩ := trace_exists count.val before
  exact ⟨after,NBG_SquareTrace.native_result count before after trace,trace,positive trace⟩

#print axioms preserve
#print axioms positive
#print axioms trace_exists
#print axioms source
end NEB_SquareDomains
end

NBG_SquareTrace.source:
import NBG_SquareLoop
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBG_SquareTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow AspisR1
open AspisR1M31Inverse.SquareProof

/-- Native cells supply only the paired scalar natural-value relation, not a
model return or a whole-function output equality. K028 constructs each step. -/
inductive Trace : Nat → U32 → U32 → Prop
  | done (value : U32) : Trace 0 value value
  | step {n : Nat} {before middle after : U32}
      (cell : middle.val = (before.val*before.val)%2147483647)
      (tail : Trace n middle after) : Trace (n+1) before after

theorem loop_result {n : Nat} {before after : U32}
    (trace : Trace n before after) (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize)
    (count : iter.end.val-iter.start.val=n) :
    AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n_loop FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul
      iter before = ok after := by
  induction trace generalizing iter with
  | done value =>
    have stopped : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have next := AspisR1M31Inverse.SquareProof.next_done iter stopped
    unfold AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n_loop
    rw [loop.eq_def]
    simp only [AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n_loop.body,next,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  | @step n before middle after cell tail ih =>
    have active : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    obtain ⟨rest,next,inc,last,_⟩ := AspisR1M31Inverse.SquareProof.next_step iter active
    have remaining : rest.end.val-rest.start.val=n := by rw [last,inc]; omega
    obtain ⟨word,run,value,_⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source before before
    have same : word=middle := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (value.trans cell.symm)
    rw [same] at run
    unfold AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n_loop
    rw [loop.eq_def]
    simp only [AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n_loop.body,next,run,bind_tc_ok]
    exact ih rest remaining

/-- Exact raw scalar Result for the SAME native loop trace, including count0. -/
theorem native_result (count : Usize) (before after : U32)
    (trace : Trace count.val before after) :
    AspisR1M31Inverse.field.square_n FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul before count =
      ok after := by
  apply loop_result trace {start:=0#usize,«end»:=count}
  simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,Nat.sub_zero]

#print axioms loop_result
#print axioms native_result
end NBG_SquareTrace

NEW_GeometryReverse.source:
import NET_GeometryAllocation
import Port4C_BatchInverse
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEW_GeometryReverse
open Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1
open S7Kani2PrefixLoop (wordMul)
open Port4C_BatchInverse (cell)

/-- Pointwise native write observations identify the SAME output list, including
all unmodified cells. No independently selected whole-output equality is assumed. -/
theorem write_from_windows (before after : List U32) (index : Nat) (value : U32)
    (active : index < before.length) (size : after.length = before.length)
    (windows : ∀ j, j < before.length →
      after[j]? = if j = index then some value else before[j]?) :
    after = before.set index value := by
  apply List.ext_getElem?
  intro j
  by_cases h : j < before.length
  · rw [windows j h]
    by_cases same : j = index
    · subst j
      simp only [ite_true,List.getElem?_set_self active]
    · simp only [same,if_false,List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm same)]
  · have ha : after.length ≤ j := by omega
    have hb : (before.set index value).length ≤ j := by simpa only [List.length_set] using (show before.length ≤ j by omega)
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none ha,List.getElem?_eq_none hb]

/-- One step uses two ordered products. Their replies have already been
instantiated by the existing emitted multiplication law; no arithmetic Kani. -/
inductive Trace (flat prefixes : List U32) :
    Nat → List U32 → U32 → List U32 → U32 → List (U32 × U32) → Prop
 | done (inverse : List U32) (suffix : U32) :
     Trace flat prefixes 0 inverse suffix inverse suffix []
 | step (n : Nat) (inverse next final : List U32) (suffix finalSuffix : U32)
     (tailCalls : List (U32 × U32))
     (active : n < inverse.length)
     (size : next.length = inverse.length)
     (windows : ∀ j, j < inverse.length → next[j]? =
       if j = n then some (wordMul suffix (cell prefixes n)) else inverse[j]?)
     (tail : Trace flat prefixes n next (wordMul suffix (cell flat n)) final finalSuffix tailCalls) :
     Trace flat prefixes (n+1) inverse suffix final finalSuffix
       ((suffix,cell prefixes n)::(suffix,cell flat n)::tailCalls)

def suffixAfter (flat : List U32) : Nat → U32 → U32
 | 0,suffix => suffix
 | n+1,suffix => suffixAfter flat n (wordMul suffix (cell flat n))

/-- The exact mutable output AND returned suffix compose by reverse induction.
This consumes every frame observation, not just the newly written cell. -/
theorem state (flat prefixes : List U32) {n : Nat} {inverse final : List U32}
    {suffix finalSuffix : U32} {calls : List (U32 × U32)}
    (trace : Trace flat prefixes n inverse suffix final finalSuffix calls) :
    final = Port4C_OwnedInverse.model flat prefixes n inverse suffix ∧
      finalSuffix = suffixAfter flat n suffix := by
  induction trace with
  | done => exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
  | step n inverse next final suffix finalSuffix calls active size windows tail ih =>
    have same := write_from_windows inverse next n (wordMul suffix (cell prefixes n)) active size windows
    rcases ih with ⟨output,returned⟩
    constructor
    · rw [output,same]
      rfl
    · exact returned

/-- The two calls in each native cell precede all calls for lower cells. -/
theorem call_count (flat prefixes : List U32) {n : Nat} {inverse final : List U32}
    {suffix finalSuffix : U32} {calls : List (U32 × U32)}
    (trace : Trace flat prefixes n inverse suffix final finalSuffix calls) :
    calls.length = 2*n := by
  induction trace with
  | done => rfl
  | step n inverse next final suffix finalSuffix calls active size windows tail ih =>
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega

/-- Deterministic ordered effects, including BOTH products before the next cell. -/
def callLog (flat prefixes : List U32) : Nat → U32 → List (U32 × U32)
 | 0,_ => []
 | n+1,suffix => (suffix,cell prefixes n)::(suffix,cell flat n)::
     callLog flat prefixes n (wordMul suffix (cell flat n))

theorem ordered_calls (flat prefixes : List U32) {n : Nat} {inverse final : List U32}
    {suffix finalSuffix : U32} {calls : List (U32 × U32)}
    (trace : Trace flat prefixes n inverse suffix final finalSuffix calls) :
    calls = callLog flat prefixes n suffix := by
  induction trace with
  | done => rfl
  | step n inverse next final suffix finalSuffix calls active size windows tail ih =>
    simp only [callLog,ih]

#print axioms write_from_windows
#print axioms state
#print axioms call_count
#print axioms ordered_calls
end NEW_GeometryReverse

NET_GeometryAllocation.source:
import NBS_GeometryDomains
import KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NET_GeometryAllocation

/-- Frame observations at every offset compose a single extend operation.
This is a value law; native allocation and live-place transport are separate. -/
theorem extend_from_windows {T : Type} (before after values : List T)
    (length : after.length = before.length + values.length)
    (windows : ∀ (offset : Nat) (valid : offset < after.length),
      after[offset] = if h : offset < before.length then before[offset]
      else values[offset-before.length]'(by omega)) :
    after = before ++ values := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_append]; exact length
  · intro offset ha hb
    rw [windows offset ha]
    by_cases inside : offset < before.length
    · simp only [dif_pos inside,List.getElem_append_left inside]
    · simp only [dif_neg inside,List.getElem_append_right (by omega : before.length ≤ offset)]

/-- Both native buffers keep their nongrowing capacity on one five-word
append and one line-word push, at the same query cursor. -/
theorem forward_invariant (count cursor flatLength lineLength : Nat)
    (bound : count ≤ 22) (active : cursor < count)
    (flat : flatLength = 5 * cursor) (line : lineLength = cursor) :
    flatLength + 5 = 5 * (cursor+1) ∧ lineLength+1 = cursor+1 ∧
    flatLength+5 ≤ 5*count ∧ lineLength+1 ≤ count ∧
    flatLength+5 ≤ 110 := by omega

/-- Exact reverse traversal bounds, including the first and final cells. -/
theorem reverse_invariant (count remaining : Nat)
    (bound : count ≤ 22) (positive : 0 < remaining) (inside : remaining ≤ 5*count) :
    remaining-1 < 5*count ∧ remaining-1 < 110 ∧
    remaining-1+1 = remaining ∧ remaining-1 < remaining := by omega

/-- A single indexed write preserves every distinct live value window. -/
theorem backward_frame {T : Type} (before : List T) (index offset : Nat) (value : T)
    (different : offset ≠ index) :
    (before.set index value)[offset]? = before[offset]? := by
  exact List.getElem?_set_ne different.symm

#print axioms extend_from_windows
#print axioms forward_invariant
#print axioms reverse_invariant
#print axioms backward_frame
end NET_GeometryAllocation

import Port4C_PrefixMeaning
import Port4C_BatchInverse
import LPf_BaseMultiply
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBS_GeometryDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std AspisR1
/-- All real geometry sizes, including empty ranges; no allocation success
or result vector is assumed. TX2 uses start10/end22. -/
theorem sizes (start stop : Nat) (order : start≤stop) (hi : stop≤22) :
    stop-start≤22 ∧ (stop-start)*5≤110 ∧
    (start=10 → stop-start≤12 ∧ (stop-start)*5≤60) := by omega

theorem aligned (u : Nat) (bound : u<262144) :
    u/4*4<262144 ∧ u/4*4+3<262144 ∧
    u/4*4≤u ∧ u≤u/4*4+3 := by omega

/-- A selected record is exactly five consecutive entries in the SAME flat
vector. This also proves the allocation/index arithmetic does not overflow. -/
theorem group (n i j : Nat) (hn : n≤22) (hi : i<n) (hj : j<5) :
    5*i+j<5*n ∧ 5*i+j<110 ∧ 5*i+j<18446744073709551616 := by omega

theorem accessor (start count index : Nat) (lo : start ≤ index) (hi : index<start+count) :
    index-start<count ∧ start+(index-start)=index := by omega

/-- Accepted zero checks and canonicality imply nonzero natural residues,
so a successful native path never inverts field zero. -/
theorem nonzero (word : Nat) (canonical : word<2147483647) (guard : word≠0) :
    word%2147483647≠0 := by rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt canonical];exact guard

#print axioms sizes
#print axioms aligned

#print axioms accessor
#print axioms nonzero
#print axioms AspisR1.Port4C_PrefixMeaning.total

end NBS_GeometryDomains

theorem remainder {α : Type} (xs : List α) (start count : Nat)
    (fit : start+count≤xs.length) :
    ((xs.drop start).take count).length=count := by simp;omega

theorem next_remainder {α : Type} (xs : List α) (start count : Nat)
    (active : 0<count) :
    ((xs.drop start).take count).drop 1=(xs.drop (start+1)).take (count-1) := by
  rw [List.drop_take,List.drop_drop]

theorem selected {α : Type} (xs : List α) (start count j : Nat) (active : j<count) :
    ((xs.drop start).take count)[j]?=xs[start+j]? := by
  rw [List.getElem?_take,if_pos active,List.getElem?_drop]

theorem shape_tail (j : Nat) (active : j<7) : 9+j<16 ∧ 9+(j+1)≤16 := by omega

theorem query_prefix (i j : Nat) (indexBound : i < 22) (prefixBound : j < i) :
    j<22 ∧ j+1 ≤ i ∧ i+1≤22 := by omega

import NET_GeometryAllocation
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NET_GeometryGather

/-- Ordered observations on the SAME two evolving buffers. The native
existence/physical association of each observation remains a separate gate. -/
inductive Trace {T : Type} : List (List T × T) → List T → List T → List T → List T → Prop
 | done (flat lines : List T) : Trace [] flat lines flat lines
 | step (row : List T × T) (rows : List (List T × T))
     (flat lines nextFlat nextLines finalFlat finalLines : List T)
     (flatStep : nextFlat = flat ++ row.1)
     (lineStep : nextLines = lines ++ [row.2]) (width : row.1.length = 5)
     (tail : Trace rows nextFlat nextLines finalFlat finalLines) :
     Trace (row::rows) flat lines finalFlat finalLines

/-- No independently chosen whole-buffer output appears as a premise. -/
theorem meaning {T : Type} {rows : List (List T × T)}
    {flat lines finalFlat finalLines : List T}
    (trace : Trace rows flat lines finalFlat finalLines) :
    finalFlat = flat ++ rows.flatMap Prod.fst ∧
      finalLines = lines ++ rows.map Prod.snd := by
  induction trace with
  | done => simp
  | step row rows flat lines nextFlat nextLines finalFlat finalLines flatStep lineStep width tail ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨hf,hl⟩
    constructor
    · rw [hf,flatStep]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons,List.append_assoc]
    · rw [hl,lineStep]
      simp only [List.map_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]

/-- Both counters advance together through every observed query. -/
theorem lengths {T : Type} {rows : List (List T × T)}
    {flat lines finalFlat finalLines : List T}
    (trace : Trace rows flat lines finalFlat finalLines) :
    finalFlat.length = flat.length + 5*rows.length ∧
      finalLines.length = lines.length + rows.length := by
  induction trace with
  | done => simp
  | step row rows flat lines nextFlat nextLines finalFlat finalLines flatStep lineStep width tail ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨hf,hl⟩
    rw [flatStep,List.length_append,width] at hf
    rw [lineStep,List.length_append,List.length_singleton] at hl
    simp only [List.length_cons]
    constructor <;> omega

/-- Reaching the prefix call after all queries establishes its exact size
on the same gathered value list. This is not native trace existence. -/
theorem prefix_domain {T : Type} {rows : List (List T × T)}
    {finalFlat finalLines : List T} (bound : rows.length ≤ 22)
    (trace : Trace rows [] [] finalFlat finalLines) :
    finalFlat.length = 5*rows.length ∧ finalFlat.length ≤ 110 ∧
      finalLines.length = rows.length := by
  obtain ⟨hf,hl⟩ := lengths trace
  simp only [List.length_nil,Nat.zero_add] at hf hl
  exact ⟨hf,by omega,hl⟩

#print axioms meaning
#print axioms lengths
#print axioms prefix_domain
end NET_GeometryGather

import NFB_PrivateFrame
import NFB_GatherChain
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_GatherFrame
open Aeneas.Std NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame NFB_GatherTrace

def actions : List Row → List Action
 | [] => []
 | r::rs => append .flat r.words :: append .lines [r.lineZ] :: actions rs

theorem owned (rows : List Row) : ∀ a∈actions rows, Private a := by
 induction rows with
 | nil => simp [actions]
 | cons r rs ih =>
  intro a ha
  simp only [actions,List.mem_cons] at ha
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl | ha
  · exact Private.append _ _
  · exact Private.append _ _
  · exact ih a ha

theorem query_frame (rows : List Row) (heap : Heap) (count : Nat) :
 run ((actions rows).take count) heap 0=heap 0 :=
 protected_query (actions rows) heap count (owned rows)

/-- The ordered two-owner writes reconstruct both buffers in the SAME heap. -/
theorem payloads (rows : List Row) (heap : Heap) (flat lines : List U32)
 (hflat : heap Place.flat.id=some flat) (hlines : heap Place.lines.id=some lines) :
 run (actions rows) heap Place.flat.id=some (flat++rows.flatMap (fun r=>r.words)) ∧
 run (actions rows) heap Place.lines.id=some (lines++rows.map (fun r=>r.lineZ)) := by
 induction rows generalizing heap flat lines with
 | nil => simp [actions,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run,hflat,hlines]
 | cons r rs ih =>
  let next := (append .lines [r.lineZ]).apply ((append .flat r.words).apply heap)
  have hf : next Place.flat.id=some (flat++r.words) := by
   simp only [Place.id] at hflat
   simp [next,append,Action.apply,write,Place.id,hflat]
  have hl : next Place.lines.id=some (lines++[r.lineZ]) := by
   simp only [Place.id] at hlines
   simp [next,append,Action.apply,write,Place.id,hlines]
  have result := ih next (flat++r.words) (lines++[r.lineZ]) hf hl
  simpa [actions,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run,next,List.flatMap_cons,List.map_cons,List.append_assoc] using result
#print axioms owned
#print axioms query_frame
#print axioms payloads
end NFB_GatherFrame

import NFB_PhysicalFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_PrivateFrame
open Aeneas.Std NFB_PhysicalFrame

/-- Private allocation slots cannot designate the root's protected query place.
The native interpretation maps these slots to fresh owned allocations. -/
inductive Place where
 | flat | lines | prefixes | inverse | rows
 deriving DecidableEq

def Place.id : Place → Nat
 | .flat => 1 | .lines => 2 | .prefixes => 3 | .inverse => 4 | .rows => 5

def allocate (place : Place) (value : List U32) : Action := .allocate place.id value
def store (place : Place) (offset : Nat) (value : U32) : Action := .store place.id offset value
def append (place : Place) (value : List U32) : Action := .append place.id value
def release (place : Place) : Action := .release place.id

inductive Private : Action → Prop where
 | allocate (p : Place) (v : List U32) : Private (allocate p v)
 | store (p : Place) (j : Nat) (v : U32) : Private (store p j v)
 | append (p : Place) (v : List U32) : Private (append p v)
 | release (p : Place) : Private (release p)

theorem disjoint (a : Action) (h : Private a) : 0≠a.owner := by
 cases h with
 | allocate p v => cases p <;> simp only [allocate,Action.owner,Place.id] <;> omega
 | store p j v => cases p <;> simp only [store,Action.owner,Place.id] <;> omega
 | append p v => cases p <;> simp only [append,Action.owner,Place.id] <;> omega
 | release p => cases p <;> simp only [release,Action.owner,Place.id] <;> omega

/-- Any prefix, including one ending at a rejection, preserves the SAME
protected query allocation. This is the ownership induction, not a native
receipt; the source/trace association must separately instantiate Private. -/
theorem protected_query (actions : List Action) (heap : Heap) (count : Nat)
    (owned : ∀ a∈actions, Private a) :
    run (actions.take count) heap 0=heap 0 := by
 apply prefix_frame
 intro a ha
 exact disjoint a (owned a ha)

#print axioms disjoint
#print axioms protected_query
end NFB_PrivateFrame

NFB_PhysicalFrame.source:
import NFB_ZeroScan
import KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_PhysicalFrame
open Aeneas.Std

/-- Allocation identities, rather than equal contents, select physical places.
The interpretation of these identities in native memory is P6. -/
abbrev Heap := Nat → Option (List U32)

def write (heap : Heap) (owner : Nat) (value : Option (List U32)) : Heap :=
  fun place => if place=owner then value else heap place

inductive Action where
 | allocate (owner : Nat) (value : List U32)
 | store (owner offset : Nat) (value : U32)
 | append (owner : Nat) (values : List U32)
 | release (owner : Nat)

def Action.owner : Action → Nat
 | .allocate o _ | .store o _ _ | .append o _ | .release o => o

def Action.apply (action : Action) (heap : Heap) : Heap :=
 match action with
 | .allocate o v => write heap o (some v)
 | .store o j v => write heap o ((heap o).map (fun xs => xs.set j v))
 | .append o v => write heap o ((heap o).map (fun xs => xs++v))
 | .release o => write heap o none

def run : List Action → Heap → Heap
 | [],heap => heap
 | action::tail,heap => run tail (action.apply heap)

theorem other_place (action : Action) (heap : Heap) (place : Nat)
    (disjoint : place ≠ action.owner) : action.apply heap place=heap place := by
 cases action <;> simp only [Action.apply,Action.owner] at * <;>
   simp only [write,disjoint,if_false]

/-- No update, allocation or release in the actual ordered private-buffer
trace can change the protected allocation. Repeated writes keep SAME identity. -/
theorem trace_frame (actions : List Action) (heap : Heap) (place : Nat)
    (disjoint : ∀ a ∈ actions, place≠a.owner) : run actions heap place=heap place := by
 induction actions generalizing heap with
 | nil => rfl
 | cons action tail ih =>
   rw [run,ih (action.apply heap) (fun a ha => disjoint a (List.mem_cons_of_mem action ha))]
   exact other_place action heap place (disjoint action (List.mem_cons_self))

/-- Extensional observation of the SAME owner reconstructs its whole payload;
a separately selected buffer with equal length is insufficient. -/
theorem same_payload (heap : Heap) (owner : Nat) (before after : List U32)
    (selected : heap owner=some after) (size : after.length=before.length)
    (windows : ∀ j, j<before.length → after[j]?=before[j]?) :
    heap owner=some before := by
 have same : after=before := by
  apply List.ext_getElem?
  intro j
  by_cases h : j<before.length
  · exact windows j h
  · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : after.length≤j),
      List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : before.length≤j)]
 rw [selected,same]

/-- Frame transport also covers a rejected finite prefix; no accepted-only
restriction is used. -/
theorem prefix_frame (actions : List Action) (heap : Heap) (place count : Nat)
    (disjoint : ∀ a ∈ actions, place≠a.owner) :
    run (actions.take count) heap place=heap place := by
 apply trace_frame
 intro a ha
 exact disjoint a (List.mem_of_mem_take ha)

#print axioms other_place
#print axioms trace_frame
#print axioms same_payload
#print axioms prefix_frame
end NFB_PhysicalFrame

import NFB_ReverseTrace
import NFB_CollectAssociation
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_TerminalFrame
open Aeneas.Std AspisR1 NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame

def resize : Nat → List Action
 | 0 => []
 | n+1 => append .inverse [0#u32] :: resize n

def collect : List (Array U32 5#usize) → List Action
 | [] => []
 | row::rs => append .rows row.val :: collect rs

def actions (flat prefixes : List U32) (suffix : U32) (count : Nat)
 (groups : List (Array U32 5#usize)) : List Action :=
 [allocate .prefixes prefixes,allocate .inverse []]++resize count++
 NFB_ReverseTrace.writes flat prefixes count suffix++
 [allocate .rows []]++collect groups++
 [release .inverse,release .prefixes,release .flat]

theorem resize_owned (n : Nat) : ∀ a∈resize n,Private a := by
 induction n with
 | zero => simp [resize]
 | succ n ih =>
  intro a ha
  simp only [resize,List.mem_cons] at ha
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · exact Private.append _ _
  · exact ih a ha

theorem collect_owned (groups : List (Array U32 5#usize)) : ∀ a∈collect groups,Private a := by
 induction groups with
 | nil => simp [collect]
 | cons row rs ih =>
  intro a ha
  simp only [collect,List.mem_cons] at ha
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · exact Private.append _ _
  · exact ih a ha

theorem owned (flat prefixes : List U32) (suffix : U32) (count : Nat)
 (groups : List (Array U32 5#usize)) :
 ∀ a∈actions flat prefixes suffix count groups,Private a := by
 intro a ha
 simp only [actions,List.mem_append] at ha
 rcases ha with ((((h0 | hr) | hw) | hrow) | hc) | hrel
 · simp only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at h0
   rcases h0 with rfl | rfl <;> exact Private.allocate _ _
 · exact resize_owned count a hr
 · exact NFB_ReverseTrace.owned flat prefixes count suffix a hw
 · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hrow
   subst a
   exact Private.allocate _ _
 · exact collect_owned groups a hc
 · simp only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at hrel
   rcases hrel with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact Private.release _

theorem query_frame (flat prefixes : List U32) (suffix : U32) (count : Nat)
 (groups : List (Array U32 5#usize)) (heap : Heap) (countTaken : Nat) :
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run ((actions flat prefixes suffix count groups).take countTaken) heap 0=heap 0 :=
 protected_query _ heap countTaken (owned flat prefixes suffix count groups)
#print axioms resize_owned
#print axioms collect_owned
#print axioms owned
#print axioms query_frame
end NFB_TerminalFrame

import NFB_RootGather
import NEW_GeometryReverse
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_ReverseTrace
open Aeneas.Std AspisR1 NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame
open S7Kani2PrefixLoop (wordMul)
open Port4C_BatchInverse (cell)

def writes (flat prefixes : List U32) : Nat → U32 → List Action
 | 0,_ => []
 | n+1,s => store .inverse n (wordMul s (cell prefixes n)) ::
    writes flat prefixes n (wordMul s (cell flat n))

theorem complete (flat prefixes inverse : List U32) (n : Nat) (suffix : U32)
 (bound : n ≤ inverse.length) :
 NEW_GeometryReverse.Trace flat prefixes n inverse suffix
  (Port4C_OwnedInverse.model flat prefixes n inverse suffix)
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.suffixAfter flat n suffix)
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.callLog flat prefixes n suffix) := by
 induction n generalizing inverse suffix with
 | zero => exact NEW_GeometryReverse.Trace.done _ _
 | succ n ih =>
  apply NEW_GeometryReverse.Trace.step n inverse
   (inverse.set n (wordMul suffix (cell prefixes n)))
   (Port4C_OwnedInverse.model flat prefixes (n+1) inverse suffix)
   suffix (NEW_GeometryReverse.suffixAfter flat (n+1) suffix)
   (NEW_GeometryReverse.callLog flat prefixes n (wordMul suffix (cell flat n)))
  · omega
  · exact List.length_set
  · intro j hj
    by_cases same : j=n
    · subst j
      simp only [ite_true,List.getElem?_set_self (by omega : n < inverse.length)]
    · simp only [same,if_false,List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm same)]
  · exact ih _ _ (by simpa only [List.length_set] using (show n ≤ inverse.length by omega))

theorem owned (flat prefixes : List U32) (n : Nat) (suffix : U32) :
 ∀ a∈writes flat prefixes n suffix,Private a := by
 induction n generalizing suffix with
 | zero => simp [writes]
 | succ n ih =>
  intro a ha
  simp only [writes,List.mem_cons] at ha
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · exact Private.store _ _ _
  · exact ih _ a ha

theorem payload (flat prefixes inverse : List U32) (n : Nat) (suffix : U32)
 (heap : Heap) (selected : heap Place.inverse.id=some inverse) :
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (writes flat prefixes n suffix) heap Place.inverse.id=
 some (Port4C_OwnedInverse.model flat prefixes n inverse suffix) := by
 induction n generalizing inverse suffix heap with
 | zero => exact selected
 | succ n ih =>
  change NFB_PhysicalFrame.run
   (writes flat prefixes n (wordMul suffix (cell flat n)))
   ((store .inverse n (wordMul suffix (cell prefixes n))).apply heap)
   Place.inverse.id=_
  apply ih
  simp only [store,Action.apply,write,ite_true,selected,Option.map_some,cell]
#print axioms complete
#print axioms owned
#print axioms payload
end NFB_ReverseTrace

import NFB_PhysicalFrame
import NFB_ResizeTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_CollectorTrace
open Aeneas.Std

/-- Only initialized live payload is exposed. Publication remains zero until
SetLenOnDrop finishes; this models the pinned TrustedLen specialization. -/
structure Guard (A : Type) where
 initialized : List A
 published : Nat
 deriving Repr

def store {A : Type} (s : Guard A) (x : A) : Guard A :=
 ⟨s.initialized++[x],s.published⟩
def finish {A : Type} (s : Guard A) : Guard A :=
 ⟨s.initialized,s.initialized.length⟩
def fill {A : Type} : List A → Guard A → Guard A
 | [],s => s
 | x::xs,s => fill xs (store s x)

theorem stores {A : Type} (xs : List A) (s : Guard A) :
 (fill xs s).initialized=s.initialized++xs ∧ (fill xs s).published=s.published := by
 induction xs generalizing s with
 | nil => simp [fill]
 | cons x xs ih =>
  have h := ih (store s x)
  simpa [fill,store,List.append_assoc] using h

theorem complete {A : Type} (xs : List A) :
 finish (fill xs (⟨[],0⟩ : Guard A))=⟨xs,xs.length⟩ := by
 have h:=stores xs (⟨[],0⟩ : Guard A)
 simp only [List.nil_append] at h
 simp only [finish,h.1]

/-- Arbitrary old live windows and the new slot reconstruct one SAME-buffer
store. This law is shared by array initialization and row collection. -/
theorem window_step {A : Type} (before after : List A) (value : A)
 (size : after.length=before.length+1)
 (old : ∀ j,j<before.length → after[j]?=before[j]?)
 (new : after[before.length]?=some value) : after=before++[value] := by
 apply List.ext_getElem?
 intro j
 by_cases active : j<before.length
 · rw [old j active,List.getElem?_append_left active]
 · by_cases last : j=before.length
   · subst j
     rw [new,List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
     simp only [Nat.sub_self,List.getElem?_cons_zero]
   · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : after.length≤j),
       List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton];omega)]

inductive Trace {A : Type} : List A → Guard A → Guard A → Prop where
 | done (s : Guard A) : Trace [] s s
 | step (x : A) (xs : List A) (s next out : Guard A)
  (size : next.initialized.length=s.initialized.length+1)
  (old : ∀ j,j<s.initialized.length → next.initialized[j]?=s.initialized[j]?)
  (new : next.initialized[s.initialized.length]?=some x)
  (unpublished : next.published=s.published)
  (tail : Trace xs next out) : Trace (x::xs) s out

theorem meaning {A : Type} {xs : List A} {before after : Guard A}
 (trace : Trace xs before after) : after=fill xs before := by
 induction trace with
 | done => rfl
 | step x xs s next out size old new unpublished tail ih =>
  have h:=window_step s.initialized next.initialized x size old new
  have same : next=store s x := by cases next;cases s;simp_all [store]
  rw [ih,same]
  rfl
#print axioms stores
#print axioms complete
#print axioms window_step
#print axioms meaning
end NFB_CollectorTrace

NFB_ResizeTrace.source:
import NET_GeometryAllocation
import NFB_PhysicalFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_ResizeTrace
open Aeneas.Std

/-- One native resize window reconstructs exactly one appended zero, retaining
all old values. Both observations concern the SAME before/after allocation. -/
theorem step (before after : List U32)
    (size : after.length=before.length+1)
    (old : ∀ j, j<before.length → after[j]?=before[j]?)
    (new : after[before.length]?=some 0#u32) : after=before++[0#u32] := by
 apply List.ext_getElem?
 intro j
 by_cases h : j<before.length
 · rw [old j h,List.getElem?_append_left h]
 · by_cases same : j=before.length
   · subst j
     rw [new,List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)]
     simp only [Nat.sub_self,List.getElem?_cons_zero]
   · rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega : after.length≤j),
       List.getElem?_eq_none (by simp only [List.length_append,List.length_singleton]; omega)]

inductive Trace : Nat → List U32 → List U32 → Prop where
 | done (before : List U32) : Trace 0 before before
 | step (n : Nat) (before next final : List U32)
     (size : next.length=before.length+1)
     (old : ∀ j, j<before.length → next[j]?=before[j]?)
     (new : next[before.length]?=some 0#u32)
     (tail : Trace n next final) : Trace (n+1) before final

/-- Whole-buffer value law from one native iteration and an induction, without
unwinding a resize or assuming its whole output as a premise. -/
theorem complete {n : Nat} {before after : List U32} (trace : Trace n before after) :
    after=before++List.replicate n 0#u32 := by
 induction trace with
 | done => simp only [List.replicate_zero,List.append_nil]
 | step n before next final size old new tail ih =>
   rw [ih,step before next size old new,List.append_assoc]
   simp only [List.replicate_succ,List.singleton_append]

#print axioms step
#print axioms complete
end NFB_ResizeTrace

theorem model_length (flat prefixes : List U32) (product : U32) :
 (S7Kani2PrefixLoop.model flat prefixes product).1.length=prefixes.length+flat.length := by
 induction flat generalizing prefixes product with
 | nil => simp [S7Kani2PrefixLoop.model]

 ∃ (prefixes : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (product : U32),
 adopted.op13 flat.deref=ok (prefixes,product) ∧ prefixes.val.length=flat.val.length := by

 · have values:=congrArg (fun p : List U32 × U32=>p.1.length) meaning
   rw [model_length] at values

/-- SAME terminal buffers and actual child Results instantiate every native
reverse/collect domain. Child success is derived from this accepted terminal. -/
theorem complete (start : Usize) (it : It) (lines flat : Vec)
 (out : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.QueryGeometry)
 (ending : it.i=it.slice.val.length) (nonempty : flat.val≠[])
 (count : lines.val.length≤22) (size : flat.val.length=5*lines.val.length)
 (accepted : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0.body adopted
  start it lines flat=ok (done (.Ok out))) :
 ∃ (prefixes : Vec) (product suffix : U32) (resized inverse : Vec),
 adopted.op13 flat.deref=ok (prefixes,product) ∧ prefixes.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
 adopted.op11 product=ok suffix ∧ resized.val=List.replicate flat.val.length 0#u32 ∧
 NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0_loop0
  (Port4C_Reverse.reverse (alloc.vec.Vec.len flat)) flat prefixes suffix resized=ok inverse ∧
 inverse.val.length=flat.val.length ∧
 NEW_GeometryReverse.Trace flat.val prefixes.val flat.val.length resized.val suffix inverse.val
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.suffixAfter flat.val flat.val.length suffix)
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.callLog flat.val prefixes.val flat.val.length suffix) ∧
 out.inverses.val=(List.range lines.val.length).map (Port4C_CollectLoop.record inverse) ∧
 NFB_CollectorTrace.finish
  (NFB_CollectorTrace.fill out.inverses.val (⟨[],0⟩ : NFB_CollectorTrace.Guard (Array U32 5#usize)))=
  ⟨out.inverses.val,out.inverses.val.length⟩ := by
 obtain ⟨prefixes,product,suffix,zero,resized,inverse,rev,mapped,groups,
  hp,hs,hz,hr,hrev,hback,hmap,hcollect,startField,lineField,groupsField⟩ :=
  NFB_TerminalCuts.complete start it lines flat out ending nonempty accepted
 obtain ⟨ps,prod,prefixRun,prefixLen⟩ := NFB_PrefixDomain.complete flat (by omega)
 have same : (ps,prod)=(prefixes,product) := Result.ok.inj (prefixRun.symm.trans hp)
 cases same
 have zeroValue : zero=0#u32 := (Result.ok.inj hz).symm
 subst zero
 obtain ⟨rs,resizeRun,resizeValue⟩ := NFB_ResizeAssociation.complete (alloc.vec.Vec.len flat)
 have sameResize : rs=resized := Result.ok.inj (resizeRun.symm.trans hr)
 subst rs
 have resizeLength : resized.val.length=flat.val.length := by
  rw [resizeValue,List.length_replicate]
  rfl
 have revValue : rev=Port4C_Reverse.reverse (alloc.vec.Vec.len flat) := (Result.ok.inj hrev).symm
 subst rev
 have native : NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0_loop0
  (Port4C_Reverse.reverse (alloc.vec.Vec.len flat)) flat prefixes suffix resized=ok inverse := by
  rw [NFB_BackwardTransport.complete]
  exact hback
 let heap : Heap := fun p=>if p=Place.inverse.id then some resized.val else none
 obtain ⟨other,otherRun,trace,physical,frame⟩ := NFB_ReverseAssociation.complete flat prefixes resized suffix
  (alloc.vec.Vec.len flat) (by change flat.val.length≤110;omega)
  (by rfl) (by change flat.val.length≤prefixes.val.length;omega)
  (by change flat.val.length ≤ resized.val.length;omega) heap (by simp [heap])
 have sameInverse : other=inverse := Result.ok.inj (otherRun.symm.trans native)
 subst other
 have inverseLength : inverse.val.length=flat.val.length := by
  have t:=NEW_GeometryReverse.state flat.val prefixes.val trace
  rw [t.1]
  have preserve : ∀ (n : Nat) (xs : List U32) (s : U32),
      (Port4C_OwnedInverse.model flat.val prefixes.val n xs s).length=xs.length := by
   intro n
   induction n with
   | zero => intros;rfl
   | succ n ih => intro xs s;rw [Port4C_OwnedInverse.model,ih,List.length_set]
  rw [preserve,resizeLength]
 obtain ⟨collected,collectRun,contents,length⟩ := Port4C_CollectLoop.total
  (Port4C_GeometryInverse.install
   (NEB_ActualGeometryModel.install NEW_GeometryRawInterface.ops NEW_GeometryDictionary.err))
  inverse (alloc.vec.Vec.len lines) count (by simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.len_val] using inverseLength.trans size)
 have mappedValue : mapped=⟨{start:=0#usize,«end»:=alloc.vec.Vec.len lines},inverse⟩ := (Result.ok.inj hmap).symm
 subst mapped
 have sameGroups : collected=groups := Result.ok.inj (collectRun.symm.trans hcollect)
 subst collected
 refine ⟨prefixes,product,suffix,resized,inverse,hp,prefixLen,hs,resizeValue,native,inverseLength,trace,?_,?_⟩
 · rw [groupsField]
   exact contents
 · exact NFB_CollectorTrace.complete out.inverses.val
#print axioms complete
end NFB_TerminalAssociation

theorem complete (flat prefixes inverse : alloc.vec.Vec U32) (suffix : U32) (index : Usize)
 (bound : index.val≤110) (hf : index.val≤flat.val.length)
 (hp : index.val≤prefixes.val.length) (hi : index.val ≤ inverse.val.length)
 (heap : Heap) (selected : heap Place.inverse.id=some inverse.val) :
 ∃ out : alloc.vec.Vec U32,
 NEW_GeometryActual.verifier.QueryGeometry.for_range_loop0_loop0
  (Port4C_Reverse.reverse index) flat prefixes suffix inverse=ok out ∧
 NEW_GeometryReverse.Trace flat.val prefixes.val index.val inverse.val suffix out.val
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.suffixAfter flat.val index.val suffix)
  (NEW_GeometryReverse.callLog flat.val prefixes.val index.val suffix) ∧
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_ReverseTrace.writes flat.val prefixes.val index.val suffix)
  heap Place.inverse.id=some out.val ∧
 (∀ count,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run
  ((NFB_ReverseTrace.writes flat.val prefixes.val index.val suffix).take count) heap 0=heap 0) := by
 obtain ⟨out,owned,meaning,length⟩ := Port4C_OwnedInverse.inverse_refines
  flat prefixes inverse suffix index bound hf hp hi
 have multiply : ops.op9=AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul := by

  exact NEW_GeometryArithmetic.multiply_probe x y

   exact trace
 · rw [meaning]
   exact physical

import NFB_TerminalFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFB_ResizeAssociation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NFB_PhysicalFrame NFB_PrivateFrame

theorem complete (count : Usize) :
 ∃ out : alloc.vec.Vec U32,
 alloc.vec.Vec.resize core.marker.CopyU32.cloneInst
  (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U32 count) count 0#u32=ok out ∧
 out.val=List.replicate count.val 0#u32 := by
 obtain ⟨out,run,values⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
  (alloc.vec.Vec.resize_spec core.marker.CopyU32.cloneInst
   (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U32 count) count 0#u32 rfl)
 refine ⟨out,run,?_⟩
 simpa [alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity,List.resize] using values

theorem payload (count : Nat) (heap : Heap)
 (selected : heap Place.inverse.id=some []) :
 NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_TerminalFrame.resize count) heap Place.inverse.id=
 some (List.replicate count 0#u32) := by
 have general : ∀ (n : Nat) (before : List U32) (heap : Heap),
    heap Place.inverse.id=some before →
    NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_TerminalFrame.resize n) heap Place.inverse.id=
    some (before++List.replicate n 0#u32) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => intro before heap h;simpa only [NFB_TerminalFrame.resize,NFB_PhysicalFrame.run,List.replicate_zero,List.append_nil] using h
  | succ n ih =>
   intro before heap h
   change NFB_PhysicalFrame.run (NFB_TerminalFrame.resize n)
    ((append .inverse [0#u32]).apply heap) Place.inverse.id=_
   have next : (append .inverse [0#u32]).apply heap Place.inverse.id=some (before++[0#u32]) := by
    simp only [append,Action.apply,write,ite_true,h,Option.map_some]
   have result:=ih (before++[0#u32]) _ next
   simpa only [List.append_assoc,List.replicate_succ,List.singleton_append] using result
 simpa only [List.nil_append] using general count [] heap selected
#print axioms complete
#print axioms payload
end NFB_ResizeAssociation
